name: SPEEDCRAFT AIR - Soft Tact Black - HiPER Red Multilayer Mirror
description:
Take control of air. This is the next revolution in performance eyewear.

Speedcraft AIR incorporates a built-in nasal dilator from AC Systems, allowing riders to control nasal dilation from minimum to maximum. Race-tested by three-time UCI Road World Champion Peter Sagan, this system is engineered to outpace the peloton.

Speedcraft AIR is the only cycling eyewear in the world to feature the patented AC Systems breathing technology, and comes with magnetic nose stickers to secure and properly operate the system. The nasal dilator is adjusted by rotating a small dial in the center of the lens, and the magnetic arms can be opened or closed to control nasal dilation throughout a ride.

This revolutionary breathing technology is incorporated into the award-winning Speedcraft sunglass recognized for its expansive 360 degree visibility. The large shield lens utilizes a scratch resistant HYDROILO coating which repels oil and water. TR90 frame design allows for enhanced space between lens and face to increase airflow and prevent fogging. Finished with ultra-grip rubber coasted temple arms, the Speedcraft AIR rests on the face comfortably, and stays in place no matter how much you sweat.

  • Expansive single-lens shield offers 360 degree visibility for unobstructed views and optimal field of vision
  • AC Systems built-in nasal dilator controls nasal dilation with adjustment of small dial in the center of the lens from minimum to maximum levels
  • Nasal dilation is increased on demand to assist with the regulation of nose breathing to balance the correct ratio of gases entering your lungs in the proper sequence
  • The Speedcraft AIR is fully adjustable to easily change the flow of air while you're riding. This allows you to better control your breathing.
  • Ultra-grip rubber temple tips offer a secure fit no matter how much you sweat
  • Enhanced space between lens and face increases airflow and prevents fogging
  • Temple arm scoops form a secure fit to your head and manage moisture
  • Wrap-around design reduces movement on your face
  • HiPER lens technology enhances color and clarity
  • Filter Category 2
  • Light Transmission 21%
  • Clear Lens: Filter Category 0, Light Transmission 93%

name: Axor Brutale Airwaves Full Face Helmet with Dual Spoilers
description:
Axor Brutale Airwaves Full-Face Helmet – ISI, DOT & ECE 22.06 Certified

The Axor Brutale Airwaves is a full-face motorcycle helmet designed for riders who want adventure-touring styling with race-level protection. Its shell features a subtle topographic contour-line graphic that wraps across the crown, paired with bold color-blocked accents on the chin bar and sides for a rugged, all-terrain look. The signature "AXOR" branding runs across the front, while a sleek metallic "X" logo sits at the crown. This helmet is available in three striking colorways — Black-Red, Dull Black-Red, and White-Orange — giving riders the flexibility to match their bike and personal style.

 

Key Features

  • Dual System Spoilers — an integrated rear spoiler design for improved aerodynamic stability at high speed and reduced wind buffeting
  • Pinlock-ready visor — clear, scratch-resistant shield compatible with Pinlock lens for anti-fog performance in all weather
  • Multi-point ventilation — top and rear vents for efficient airflow and reduced heat build-up
  • Quick-release visor mechanism — smooth, secure locking system for easy visor replacement
  • Removable, washable interior liner — for all-day comfort and hygiene
  • Lightweight shell construction — approx. 1600g ± 50g, reducing neck strain on long rides

Certification & Safety

The Axor Brutale Airwaves is built to meet globally recognized safety standards, clearly marked on the rear shell:

  • ISI Certified (IS:4151) — meets Indian Standards Institute requirements for two-wheeler helmets
  • DOT Certified (FMVSS No. 218) — meets U.S. Department of Transportation safety standards
  • ECE 22.06 Certified — the latest European safety standard for rigorous impact and rotational testing
  • Final QC1 Passed — every unit clears final quality control before dispatch

Available Colors

  • Black Red

name: Axor Tageze Medical Sticker
description:
Protection Doesn't End at Impact.

A helmet is designed to protect your head during an accident.

But what happens when you cannot speak?

In an emergency, people around you may not know your blood group, allergies, medical conditions, medications, emergency contact or other important information.

The AXOR Medical ID Sticker, powered by Tageze, gives riders a simple way to make selected emergency information accessible through a QR code attached to their helmet.

When the QR code is scanned using a smartphone camera, the rider's secure Tageze emergency profile can be accessed.

One sticker. One scan. Critical information when it matters.

 

Smart Emergency Identification for Riders

QR-Based Emergency Access

A unique QR code connects the physical sticker to the rider's emergency profile.

No App Required

A person scanning the QR code does not need to install a dedicated application.

No Special Equipment

A standard smartphone camera can be used to scan the QR code.

No Subscription

The product is designed to provide a simple emergency identification solution without requiring a recurring subscription for the basic service.

Update Anytime

Medical information can change.

Users can update their emergency profile when required.

Hide Mode

Users can hide their emergency profile when they do not want the information to be publicly accessible through the sticker.

Scan Alerts

Users can receive a notification when their medical profile is accessed through a tag scan.

Multiple Tags

Multiple compatible Tageze tags can be associated with a user's account/profile.

Secure Digital Profile

Medical information is stored digitally rather than printed directly on the physical QR sticker.

Multilingual Access

The Tageze emergency profile is designed to support access across multiple languages, helping make the system useful for riders travelling internationally.

name: Pinlock 70 Film
description:
A Pinlock® lens is made to enjoy a fog-free ride. Perfect lens for daily commutes and weekend rides. Anti-fog lens in a visor-specific design combined with MaxVision™ technology for a stunning wide clear view.

Pinlock® is based on two key principles to ensure a fog-free vision. The moisture-absorbing surface of the lens effectively attracts and stores water molecules, while the airtight seal creates a thermal barrier together preventing condensation of the visor.

MaxVision™ offers wide-screen fog-free vision that maximizes the field of vision. When fitted the MaxVision Pinlock® lens integrates with the visor. This is due to the special recess area that is designed in the visor.

The system is kept in place by positioning the lens between two adjustable pins, making Pinlock the number one anti-fog solution for helmets.

This Pinlock fits perfectly only for the X-cross model.   

The Pinlock lens is easy to install. You can find an instruction guide and video for support via this link:

https://pinlock.com/brands/Axor/Adventure/Clear

name: Axor xBhp Speed of Thought Helmet
description:
Championing safe riding has always been at the core of xBhp's mission. Therefore, it was only a matter of time before xBhp ventured into designing its own helmet. The collaboration with Axor Helmets in 2019 marked a significant milestone, celebrating 16 years of xBhp. Building upon that success, we proudly introduce the second xBhp | Axor Helmet, aptly named "Speed of Thought."

As motorcycle enthusiasts, we all have an affinity for speed. However, we must recognize that nothing is swifter or more potent than the power of our own minds. It is crucial to abide by the rules of the road. This principle forms the foundation of our second helmet's design. The number "299" represents the agreed-upon maximum speed limit for modern superbikes, often referred to as the "magic number" or the "hand of God." Below it, a powerful reminder emerges: nothing surpasses the speed of our own imagination. So, why put our brains and bodies at risk by exceeding speed limits on the road?

The top of the helmet features a biker donning the first edition of the xBhp helmet, paying tribute to our roots. The back showcases xBhp's iconic philosophy of "I, the Biker." Other elements highlight the heart of the motorcycle—the engine—and the exhaust pipes that emit fiery bursts, symbolizing the extraordinary creativity our human minds possess. The majority of the helmet shell is adorned with a depiction of the human brain, representing the protection it provides, while lightning bolts emphasise the intricate network of neurons within.

This remarkable helmet was designed in collaboration with The MotoGrapher and Toxic Skins, while the meticulous assembly was carried out by the renowned craftsmen at Axor Helmets. Rest assured, it upholds the highest standards of quality.

Stay safe, ride with passion, and let the Speed of Thought helmet serve as a constant reminder of the incredible power within your own mind.

Note: 

  1. The helmet is available in a gloss finish only.
  2. 2. xBhp Speed of Thought helmet is now ISI certified.

name: DSG GP1 Riding Boots (Black Yellow
description:
DSG GP1 Riding Boots (Black Yellow Fluo)

Product Description:

DSG GP-1 RIDING BOOT - PROTECT YOUR STEP

After years of research, development, and testing, Dream Sporting Gear proudly introduces its first-ever performance riding boot — the DSG GP 1. Designed for riders who demand the perfect balance of protection, comfort, and control, this boot embodies DSG’s commitment to innovation and Indian motorcycling excellence.

Crafted from lightweight, abrasion-resistant perforated leather/ microfibre, the DSG GP-1 offers a precision fit that feels natural on and off the bike. Its ergonomic low-cut design ensures unrestricted movement while maintaining a secure and streamlined riding posture. Reinforced with strategically placed TPU protectors, it provides superior impact resistance without sacrificing flexibility. Whether you’re carving corners or navigating the city, the GP-1 keeps you stable, confident, and in control.

Construction:

  • Advanced Perforated Leather/ Microfibre Shell — Combines lightweight durability with abrasion resistance for all-weather comfort.
  • Ergonomic Design — Streamlined forefoot shaping and low-cut ankle design for natural mobility and comfort.
  • Secure Closure System — An anatomically angled Velcro strap with Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU)  puller ensures a snug and precise fit.
  • DSG Performance Rubber Sole — Custom tread pattern designed for optimal grip, water dispersion, and durability both on and off the bike.
  • Reinforced Stitching — For superior strength, structure, and longevity.
  • Rear YKK® Zip Entry — Allows easy on-and-off while maintaining a locked-in fit.

Protection:

  • External TPU Protectors — On the heel, ankle, and toe-shift zone for high-impact resistance.
  • High density Ankle Protectors — Internally layered for enhanced shock absorption.
  • CE Standards to EN Standards — Ensuring European-level safety performance.

Comfort & Performance:

  • Ventilated Flex Zones — Promote airflow and cooling in high-movement areas.
  • Removable Anatomic Insole — With PU foam for superior cushioning and arch support.
  • Breathable Internal Mesh Lining — Keeps the foot dry and comfortable during long rides.
  • DSG Toe Slider — Bi-injected TPU design 
  • 3D air mesh panels for breathability

Why Choose the DSG GP-X Riding Boot

The DSG GP-1 Riding Boot represents the culmination of years of innovation and testing by Dream Sporting Gear. Designed for Indian riders, it delivers track-inspired performance, street-ready comfort, and industry-leading protection — making it the definitive riding boot for those who live to ride.

description:
DSG Race Pro V1 Gloves


The DSG RacePro V1 is engineered to perform, built to last and to protect, and designed to look great with any of our jackets.
The next generation pair of sport gloves for the track day enthusiast has been designed with a list of features and an outspoken graphic design signature. The RacePro gloves are loaded with protective elements. Race-spec knuckle, finger, palm and cuff protection and sliders; you name it, it’s all there.

name: KYT R1R Carbon Enea Bastianini Replica 2023 Gloss Helmet
description:
KYT R1R Carbon Helmet

R1R! Inspired by MotoGP experience, this dynamic design, engineered and developed in Italy with the most advanced digital tools, has undergone rigorous testing by KYT riders to ensure top-of-the-line performance. It boasts improved aerodynamics thanks to over three years of wind tunnel testing and extensive road and track testing to optimize fluid dynamics in various riding positions—straight, braking, and cornering—for maximum rider comfort. Vertical and peripheral fields of vision of 90 and 210 degrees, respectively, “Hydrocool textile” fabrics, a visor mechanism with a rototranslation system and a “Racing Lock System” visor locking mechanism in metal alloy, the most stringent used by MotoGP riders. The R1R is the ideal helmet for the road and the track

Homologation

 

The helmet comes with ECE 22.06 and ISI certification.

Shell

 

Materials: TRICOMPOSITE (Carbon fiber, fiberglass, aramidic fiber)

The shell is made of TRICOCOMPOSITE fiber, a new composite that allows for a lighter yet more protective shell. The new composite is a blend of carbon fiber, aramid fibers, and fiberglass with different weight/breaking strengths that ensure a lightweight and significantly more impact-resistant shell. The R1R is produced in three different shell sizes: S, M, and L.


LINER

The liner is available in three sizes (S, M, and L) for improved ergonomics and is designed with variable densities. This feature allows for gradual and progressive absorption of impact energy. Although most of the impact energy is absorbed by the outer shell, thanks to its deformation, the polystyrene plays a key role in absorbing residual energy. Varying the polystyrene density in different impact zones optimizes the mechanical performance of the shell, ensuring the highest level of safety.

Visor

The scratch-resistant, variable-thickness, injected polycarbonate visor, rated optical class 1, is easy to remove thanks to a tool-free system.
The rotational-translation mechanism provides greater strength when closing. The visor is also equipped with a metal alloy “Racing Lock System.”
This mechanism reduces the risk of detachment in the event of an accident.
The R1R is designed for tear-off lenses (Not Included)

PINLOCK




R1R is ready for PINLOCK® MAX VISION 70. (NOT INCLUDED)  BUY NOW

Ventilation

Ventilation is provided by an efficient system consisting of a chin guard air intake, a large front air intake, and two side vents that work together to achieve maximum comfort. The system works in conjunction with a network of integrated channels that ensure excellent airflow inside the helmet.
The aerodynamic spoiler also acts as air extraction thanks to the Venturi effect provided by the rear extractors located beneath it.

Inners

The cheek pads and liner can be removed, washed, and replaced.
They are made of premium “Hydrocool Textile” fabric with specific fibers that offer the following characteristics:
1. They allow for rapid dissipation of body heat
2. They keep the skin cool and dry
3. They feature a special hygienic treatment
The cheek pads are easily removable in an emergency thanks to the quick-release system.

Retention System

The chinstrap features a stainless steel double D ring retention system

ACCESSORIES
 Nose guard and Chin Curtain included

Weight: Weight (approx.) grams 1450 ±50 as per shell sizes

  • User manual x 1pc

name: KYT TT Revo Combustion Gloss Black Red Helmet
description:
KYT TT Revo Helmet

TT-Revo, the KYT full face helmet whose shell is produced in ADT-advanced thermoplastic, a mix of thermoplastic resins with high resistance to crashes.
Its captivating and extreme shapes have been studied in the wind tunnel, to achieve the best performances without neglecting style and ergonomic.
The fine visor mechanism has been designed to offer practicality and efficiency at the same time. Precious inners have been optimized to offer the best performance for comfort and outflow of the air.
The collaboration with aeronautics engineer, the use of special software and the wind tunnel gave life to this innovative helmet: strong, comfortable and performing. TT-Revo, the racing helmet to stand out every day.

Homologation:
The helmet comes with ECE 22.06 and ISI certification.

Shell:

Shell is made in three sizes (S, M and L), ADT-advanced thermoplastic, a mix of thermoplastic resins with high resistance to crashes.

Protective Polystyrene:

Internal polystyrene realized in three sizes (XS, M and L) to obtain a better ergonomics and a variable density. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the energy produced by the impact. Even if the bigger part of the energy created by the impact is absorbed by the external shell, thanks to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is determinant for the absorption of the residual energy.

Visor:

 The visor is made of polycarbonate, with anti-scratch treatment. The new ratchet allows the visor removal without tools. TT-Revo has a brand new lock system (PAT PEND) to fix the visor during the riding in the close position.

  

Pinlock: TT Revo is MAX PINLOCK 70 ready.
Note: Pinlock Antifog Lens NOT INCLUDED

Ventilation :

Particular channelings obtained on polystyrene allow to work in symbiosis with the several air intakes to obtain an optimal ventilation into the helmet and a quickly exhaust of the hot air. TT Revo has five air intakes on the front and four air extractors under the aerodynamics spoiler.

Inners:

They are made of soft breathable bi-elastic fabric with synthetic fibers, that offer a high sweat absorption and keep fresh and dry. The cheek pads are easily removable and they are available with different thickness.

Retention System:
The retention system is equipped of Double D Rings.

R1R! Inspired by MotoGP experience, this dynamic design, engineered and developed in Italy with the most advanced digital tools, has undergone rigorous testing by KYT riders to ensure top-of-the-line performance. It boasts improved aerodynamics thanks to over three years of wind tunnel testing and extensive road and track testing to optimize fluid dynamics in various riding positions—straight, braking, and cornering—for maximum rider comfort. Vertical and peripheral fields of vision of 90 and 210 degrees, respectively, “Hydrocool textile” fabrics, a visor mechanism with a rototranslation system and a “Racing Lock System” visor locking mechanism in metal alloy, the most stringent used by MotoGP riders. Homologation

 

The helmet comes with ECE 22.06 and ISI certification.

Shell

 

Materials: TRICOMPOSITE (Carbon fiber, fiberglass, aramidic fiber)

The shell is made of TRICOCOMPOSITE fiber, a new composite that allows for a lighter yet more protective shell. The new composite is a blend of carbon fiber, aramid fibers, and fiberglass with different weight/breaking strengths that ensure a lightweight and significantly more impact-resistant shell. The R1R is produced in three different shell sizes: S, M, and L.


LINER

The liner is available in three sizes (S, M, and L) for improved ergonomics and is designed with variable densities. This feature allows for gradual and progressive absorption of impact energy. Although most of the impact energy is absorbed by the outer shell, thanks to its deformation, the polystyrene plays a key role in absorbing residual energy. Varying the polystyrene density in different impact zones optimizes the mechanical performance of the shell, ensuring the highest level of safety.

Visor

The scratch-resistant, variable-thickness, injected polycarbonate visor, rated optical class 1, is easy to remove thanks to a tool-free system.
The rotational-translation mechanism provides greater strength when closing. The visor is also equipped with a metal alloy “Racing Lock System.”

Inners

The cheek pads and liner can be removed, washed, and replaced.
They are made of premium “Hydrocool Textile” fabric with specific fibers that offer the following characteristics:

name: KYT NZ Race Carbon Competition Gloss Black White Helmet
description:
KYT NZ Race Helmet

NZ-RACE, the KYT full-face helmet in tricomposite material derived from Kyt’s experience in the Racing world.

The shapes have been deeply studied, through fluid dynamic software and through repeated sessions in the wind tunnel, as well as on the track with the KYT riders, to achieve the best performance in terms of aerodynamics, ventilation and comfort, while at the same time enhancing the stylistic aspect characterized, as tradition, by dynamic streamlined shapes.

In particular, the spoiler has been carefully designed to achieve outstanding performance in terms of both aerodynamics and comfort.

The ventilation has also been meticulously optimized to ensure an efficient diffusion of fresh air inside the helmet and to offer, in symbiosis with the fine interior, the outflow of moisture inside the helmet. The visor is in optical class 1 and guarantees a wide peripheral and vertical field of vision, 210° and 90° respectively; anti-scratch treatment, Pinlock® Max Vision 70 anti-fog lens and reference lightness complete top-level equipment suitable for both professional use on the track and for pure fun on the road.

SPECIFICATION

SPORT TOURING - NZ Race

  • Certification: ECE 22.06 , Indian ISI 

 

 

 

Shell

  • The shell is made in two sizes (M and L) and it is made of Tri-Fiber composite, a mix of kevlar, carbon and fiber glass, to ensure a better impact resistance and lighter weight.



 

 

Protective Polystyrene 

  • The internal polystyrene is made of 3 different sizes to obtain the best ergonomics with different thickness. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the impact force generated by an impact.
  • Although most of the energy due to an impact is absorbed by the outer protective shell due to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is decisive for the absorption of residual energy.

Visor

  • The visor is made of polycarbonate with different thickness in optical class 1 and anti scratch treatment.
  • The visor is easily removable, thanks to a practical mechanism that doesn’t require any tool.
  • Pinlock Max Vision 70 Ready (Note: Lens not included with helmet) Buy Now


 

 


 

 

Ventilation

  • The internal polystyrene is studied to work in symbiosis with 3 front air intakes on the shell. Special channels on the EPS allow a non-stop air flow, ensuring a perfect ventilation inside the helmet and a rapid exhaust of the hot air through the extractors on the back, under the aerodynamic spoiler.

Inners 

  • Inners are removable and washable, in fine and soft fabrics made of fiber that, together with particular sponges, eases the air flow, maintaining dry and fresh the part in contact with the face.
  • Cheeck pads are ready for Bluetooth headphone, have an emergency system to quickly remove them in case of needs and they have “glasses wearable” predisposition.

 

 

 

Retention System

  • The retention system used is the 'Double D-RING' in light alloy.

 

 

 

Weight

  • Weight (approx.) gr 1400 ± 50

name: KYT TT Revo Speeding Gloss White Red Helmet
description:
KYT TT Revo Helmet

TT-Revo, the KYT full face helmet whose shell is produced in ADT-advanced thermoplastic, a mix of thermoplastic resins with high resistance to crashes.
Its captivating and extreme shapes have been studied in the wind tunnel, to achieve the best performances without neglecting style and ergonomic.
The fine visor mechanism has been designed to offer practicality and efficiency at the same time. Precious inners have been optimized to offer the best performance for comfort and outflow of the air.
The collaboration with aeronautics engineer, the use of special software and the wind tunnel gave life to this innovative helmet: strong, comfortable and performing. TT-Revo, the racing helmet to stand out every day.

Homologation:
The helmet comes with ECE 22.06 and ISI certification.

 Shell:

 Shell is made in three sizes (S, M and L), ADT-advanced thermoplastic, a mix of   thermoplastic resins with high resistance to crashes.

Protective Polystyrene:

Internal polystyrene realized in three sizes (XS, M and L) to obtain a better ergonomics and a variable density. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the energy produced by the impact. Even if the bigger part of the energy created by the impact is absorbed by the external shell, thanks to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is determinant for the absorption of the residual energy.

Visor:

 The visor is made of polycarbonate, with anti-scratch treatment. The new ratchet allows the visor removal without tools. TT-Revo has a brand new lock system (PAT PEND) to fix the visor during the riding in the close position.

  

Pinlock: TT Revo is MAX PINLOCK 70 ready.
Note: Pinlock Antifog Lens NOT INCLUDED

Ventilation :

Particular channelings obtained on polystyrene allow to work in symbiosis with the several air intakes to obtain an optimal ventilation into the helmet and a quickly exhaust of the hot air. TT Revo has five air intakes on the front and four air extractors under the aerodynamics spoiler.

Inners:

They are made of soft breathable bi-elastic fabric with synthetic fibers, that offer a high sweat absorption and keep fresh and dry. The cheek pads are easily removable and they are available with different thickness.

Retention System:
The retention system is equipped of Double D Rings.

Technical Specification:             

  • Homologations: ECE 22 06 & ISI
  • Commercial Name:  KYT  TT-REVO
  • Description: Full face protective helmet
  • Materials shell: ADT (Advanced Thermoplastic)
  • Polystyrene: Polystyrene produced in three sizes (S-M-L)
  • Visor: Scratch Resistant Protective (Clear / Transparent) 
  • Antifog: Pinlock 70 Ready 
    Note: Pinlock Antifog Lens NOT INCLUDED
  • Retention System: DD rings
  • Spare parts: Nose deflector and chin guard
  • Approx. Weight: 1550 ± 50 grams in Large shell

description:
KYT NZ Race Helmet

NZ-RACE, the KYT full-face helmet in tricomposite material derived from Kyt’s experience in the Racing world.

The shapes have been deeply studied, through fluid dynamic software and through repeated sessions in the wind tunnel, as well as on the track with the KYT riders, to achieve the best performance in terms of aerodynamics, ventilation and comfort, while at the same time enhancing the stylistic aspect characterized, as tradition, by dynamic streamlined shapes.

In particular, the spoiler has been carefully designed to achieve outstanding performance in terms of both aerodynamics and comfort.

The ventilation has also been meticulously optimized to ensure an efficient diffusion of fresh air inside the helmet and to offer, in symbiosis with the fine interior, the outflow of moisture inside the helmet. The visor is in optical class 1 and guarantees a wide peripheral and vertical field of vision, 210° and 90° respectively; anti-scratch treatment, Pinlock® Max Vision 70 anti-fog lens and reference lightness complete top-level equipment suitable for both professional use on the track and for pure fun on the road.

SPECIFICATION

SPORT TOURING - NZ Race

  • Certification: ECE 22.06 , Indian ISI 

 

 

 

Shell

  • The shell is made in two sizes (M and L) and it is made of Tri-Fiber composite, a mix of kevlar, carbon and fiber glass, to ensure a better impact resistance and lighter weight.



 

 

Protective Polystyrene 

  • The internal polystyrene is made of 3 different sizes to obtain the best ergonomics with different thickness. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the impact force generated by an impact.
  • Although most of the energy due to an impact is absorbed by the outer protective shell due to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is decisive for the absorption of residual energy.

Inners 

  • Inners are removable and washable, in fine and soft fabrics made of fiber that, together with particular sponges, eases the air flow, maintaining dry and fresh the part in contact with the face.
  • Cheeck pads are ready for Bluetooth headphone, have an emergency system to quickly remove them in case of needs and they have “glasses wearable” predisposition.

name: KYT KX1 RACE GP Solid Ice Matt Black Helmet
description:
KYT KX1 RACE GP Solid Carbon Gloss Helmet

Overview:

Get ready to experience the ultimate in motorcycle racing with the brand new KYT KX-1 Race GP helmet!
Designed and developed in Italy by most advanced digital tools, the KYT helmet has undergone rigorous testing by Ducati Corse Factory rider Enea Bastianini to ensure its top-of-the-line performance.
It boasts improved aerodynamics for a smoother ride and professional race performance, thanks to over three years of wind tunnel and track tests to optimize aerodynamics in various riding positions (even when cornering), enhanced peripheral field of view (92 deg and 210 deg) for a safer journey, and it meets FIM Standard (the top of the motorcycle helmet standards).
But that’s not all – KX-1 RACE GP also features a liner that has been expertly crafted for maximum comfort in all conditions. And to top it all off, it has an anti-bacterial coating to keep riders healthy and hygienic. This helmet will be used in the highly acclaimed MotoGP series and is expected to be a hit with riders everywhere.

Don’t miss out on this opportunity to upgrade your ride performance and take your motorcycle experience to the next level.

The KX-1 RACE helmet is used in MotoGP™ and continues to be adopted by world-class racers everywhere.

Shell:
The outer shell is made of Tri-Fiber composite, a mix of kevlar, carbon and fiber glass, to ensure a better impact resistance and lighter weight.

The shell is made of TRICOMPOSITE fiber, a new composite that allows to obtain a lighter but at the same time harder and more protective shell. The new composite is a mixture of carbon with different weight/breaking loads linked up with aramid resins that ensure a light but much more resistant to impacts shell. To satisfy even the most exigent customers, KX-1 RACE GP is produced in three different shells: S, M and L.


Protective Polystyrene:

Internal polystyrene liner is realized in four sizes (S, M, L and XL) to obtain a better ergonomics and a variable density. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the power produced by the impact. Even if the bigger part of the energy created by the impact is absorbed by the external shell, thanks to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is crucial for the absorption of the residual power. A different density of the polystyrene allows to optimize the mechanical performance of the shell-polystyrene, ensuring the maximum level of absorption in all areas of the helmet.

Visor:

The visor is PC injected, antiscratch, with variable thickness. Easy to remove thanks to a system that doesn’t require the use of any tool. The release lever is made of a particular metal alloy that gives greater solidity to the assembly. The visor is also equipped with a locking mechanism “Racing Lock System” in metal alloy. The mechanism reduces the possibility of detachment in case of crash. KX-1 RACE GP is prepared for racing tear off.

Pinlock:

KX-1 RACE GP is prepared and ready for PINLOCK® MAX VISION 120, the most performing antifog system in the market.
 
NOTE: Pinlock Antifog Lens NOT INCLUDED

Ventilation:

It is during the hottest Grands Prix that the most is asked to the rider, requiring concentration and endurance. Being able to count on efficient ventilation makes all the difference. KX-1 RACE GP spots seven air intake ducts which work in conjunction with a neatly integrated channel system, guaranteeing excellent airflow inside the helmet. The hot air extraction is a marvel of aerodynamics: two submerged air extractors, working together with the rear spoiler, create a Venturi effect over the exhaust ports, drawing out the hot air.

Inners :

The cheek pads and the internal comfort liners can be removed, washed and replaced. They are made of precious fabric with specific fibers that offer the following features: •  Send away sweat from the head •  Keep fresh and dry •  Light fabric, soft and breathable Cheek pads are customizable and easily removable in case of emergency thanks to the quick release system. KX-1 RACE GP is prepared for the camel-bag system.



 

Retention System:

The chin is provided with DRING retention system enabling an easy release of the retain system.

 

 

Technical Specifications:

  • Commercial Name:  KYT KX-1 RACE GP  
  • Description: Full face helmet 
  • Materials shell: Tricomposite (carbon, fiberglass, aramidic)
  • Polystyrene: Polystyrene in four sizes  (S, M, L, XL)
  • Visor: Anti-scratch with  uv 380 ray filters
  • Antifog System: Pinlock Max Vision 120 
  • Retention System: DD ring 
  • Approx. Weight: 1400 gr ±50 in size M & 1500 gr ±50 in size L

name: KYT TT Revo Plain Sea Blue Gloss Helmet
description:
KYT TT Revo Helmet

TT-Revo, the KYT full face helmet whose shell is produced in ADT-advanced thermoplastic, a mix of thermoplastic resins with high resistance to crashes.
Its captivating and extreme shapes have been studied in the wind tunnel, to achieve the best performances without neglecting style and ergonomic.
The fine visor mechanism has been designed to offer practicality and efficiency at the same time. Precious inners have been optimized to offer the best performance for comfort and outflow of the air.
The collaboration with aeronautics engineer, the use of special software and the wind tunnel gave life to this innovative helmet: strong, comfortable and performing. TT-Revo, the racing helmet to stand out every day.

Homologation:

The helmet comes with ECE 22.06 and ISI certification.

Shell:

Shell is made in three sizes (S, M and L), ADT-advanced thermoplastic, a mix of thermoplastic resins with high resistance to crashes.

Protective Polystyrene:

Internal polystyrene realized in three sizes (XS, M and L) to obtain a better ergonomics and a variable density. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the energy produced by the impact. Even if the bigger part of the energy created by the impact is absorbed by the external shell, thanks to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is determinant for the absorption of the residual energy.

Visor:

 The visor is made of polycarbonate, with anti-scratch treatment. The new ratchet allows the visor removal without tools. TT-Revo has a brand new lock system (PAT PEND) to fix the visor during the riding in the close position.

  

Pinlock: TT Revo is MAX PINLOCK 70 ready.
Note: Pinlock Antifog Lens NOT INCLUDED

Particular channelings obtained on polystyrene allow to work in symbiosis with the several air intakes to obtain an optimal ventilation into the helmet and a quickly exhaust of the hot air. TT Revo has five air intakes on the front and four air extractors under the aerodynamics spoiler.

Inners:

They are made of soft breathable bi-elastic fabric with synthetic fibers, that offer a high sweat absorption and keep fresh and dry. The cheek pads are easily removable and they are available with different thickness.

Retention System:
The retention system is equipped of Double D Rings.

KYT D-City

D-City, the new KYT urban full face helmet in thermoplastic with ADT-Advanced technology; its fascinating shapes have been deeply studied for daily use in the short and medium trips without neglecting the stylistic and ergonomic aspects. The mechanisms of the visor and air intakes have been designed to give, at the same time, easy use and efficiency.

The high-quality removable interiors have been optimized to offer the best performance in terms of comfort and moisture flow inside the helmet. The visor guarantees wide visibility and aerodynamic protection while the retractable sun visor is a comfortable and indispensable sun protection system that can be easily activated with a cable button, elegantly integrated into the shape of the shell.

Equipped with internal sun visor for daytime use.

Homologation:
The helmet comes with ECE 22.06 and ISI certification.

 
 Shell: 
 The shell is made in two sizes (M and L) and is produced in ADT-Advance, a mix of           thermoplastic resins with a very high impact resistance.
   

Protective Polystyrene:

Internal polystyrene realized in two sizes (M and L) to obtain a better ergonomics and a variable density. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the energy produced by the impact. Even if the bigger part of the energy created by the impact is absorbed by the external shell, thanks to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is determinant for the absorption of the residual energy.

Visor:

The visor is made of injection-molded polycarbonate with anti-scratch treatment. The visor is easily removable, thanks to a brand new and practical mechanism that does not require the use of tools. The wide field of vision and the aerodynamic protection of the visor make D-City an ideal helmet for short and medium-range trips.


Pinlock:

D-City is ready for Antifog PINLOCK Max Vision 120 (NOT INCLUDED)
Note: (Pinlock antifog lens sold separately)

Sun Visor:

D-City is equipped with an internal sun visor with wide protection that can be easily operated with the left hand thanks to a sliding button positioned on the lower base of the shell.

Ventilation:

Particular channelings obtained on polystyrene, allow to work in symbiosis with the several air  intakes an optimal ventilation into the helmet and a quickly exhaust of the hot air. 

Inners:

They are made of soft breathable bielastic fabric with synthetic fibers, that offer high sweat absorption and keep fresh and dry. Crown padding and cheek pads are easily removable. The cheek pads are predisposed for a bluetooth headset.


Retention System:

QRM-micrometric The retention system is equipped of micrometric buckle.

description:

TT-Revo, the KYT full face helmet whose shell is produced in ADT-advanced thermoplastic, a mix of thermoplastic resins with high resistance to crashes.

Homologation:

Shell:

Internal polystyrene realized in three sizes (XS, M and L) to obtain a better ergonomics and a variable density. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the energy produced by the impact. Even if the bigger part of the energy created by the impact is absorbed by the external shell, thanks to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is determinant for the absorption of the residual energy.

They are made of soft breathable bi-elastic fabric with synthetic fibers, that offer a high sweat absorption and keep fresh and dry. The cheek pads are easily removable and they are available with different thickness.

name: KYT TT Revo Bayliss Replica Gloss Helmet
description:
KYT TT Revo Helmet

TT-Revo, the KYT full face helmet whose shell is produced in ADT-advanced thermoplastic, a mix of thermoplastic resins with high resistance to crashes.
Its captivating and extreme shapes have been studied in the wind tunnel, to achieve the best performances without neglecting style and ergonomic.
The fine visor mechanism has been designed to offer practicality and efficiency at the same time. Precious inners have been optimized to offer the best performance for comfort and outflow of the air.
The collaboration with aeronautics engineer, the use of special software and the wind tunnel gave life to this innovative helmet: strong, comfortable and performing. TT-Revo, the racing helmet to stand out every day.

Homologation:
The helmet comes with ECE 22.06 and ISI certification.

Shell:

Shell is made in three sizes (S, M and L), ADT-advanced thermoplastic, a mix of thermoplastic resins with high resistance to crashes.

Protective Polystyrene:

Internal polystyrene realized in three sizes (XS, M and L) to obtain a better ergonomics and a variable density. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the energy produced by the impact. Even if the bigger part of the energy created by the impact is absorbed by the external shell, thanks to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is determinant for the absorption of the residual energy.

Visor:

 The visor is made of polycarbonate, with anti-scratch treatment. The new ratchet allows the visor removal without tools. TT-Revo has a brand new lock system (PAT PEND) to fix the visor during the riding in the close position.

  

Pinlock: TT Revo is MAX PINLOCK 70 ready.
Note: Pinlock Antifog Lens NOT INCLUDED

Ventilation :

Particular channelings obtained on polystyrene allow to work in symbiosis with the several air intakes to obtain an optimal ventilation into the helmet and a quickly exhaust of the hot air. TT Revo has five air intakes on the front and four air extractors under the aerodynamics spoiler.

Inners:

They are made of soft breathable bi-elastic fabric with synthetic fibers, that offer a high sweat absorption and keep fresh and dry. The cheek pads are easily removable and they are available with different thickness.

Retention System:
The retention system is equipped of Double D Rings.

name: KYT R2R Pro LED Matt Black Red Helmet
description:
KYT R2R Pro Helmet

R2R Pro, full face Helmet of KYT, in which the research of the aerodynamics performance went on in the research of the best shape. The inner comfort joins the building technology to offer the best reliability and safety for the end user.

R2R Pro is designed and produced to obtain the best airflow inside the helmet and to offer the best comfort and aerodynamics values. The cooperation with aeronautical engineers, the use of innovative software and the use of the wind tunnel created a shape right for the aim of this helmet.

SPECIFICATION

SPORT TOURING - R2R PRO

  • Certification: ECE 22.06 , Indian ISI 

 

 

 

Shell

  • Shell produced in ADT-advanced, a mix of thermoplastic resins with high resistance to crashes. R2R shell is produced in two sizes: M and L.

 

 

 

Protective Polystyrene 

  • Internal polystyrene liner realized in two sizes (M and L) to obtain a better ergonomics and a variable density.
  • This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the energy produced by the impact.

Visor

  • The visor of R2R is PC injected, scratch resistant, optic in class 1 with variable thickness combined with Pinlock Max Vision ready and Sun Visor.
  • The hooks and rotation system allows the visor removal without tools.
  • Note:
    Pinlock 70 Antifog lens available separately (OPTIONAL) - BUY NOW


 

 

  

 

 

Ventilation

  • Internal Polystyrene liner was studied to work in symbiosis with the air intake on the external shell. Particular channelings, obtained on polystyrene, allow to air flow intake an optimal ventilation into the helmet and a quickly exhaust of the hot air.

Inners 

  • The cheek pads and the internal comfort shell can be removed, washed and replaced. They are made of precious bielastic fabric with specific fibers coupled with sponges with open cells for the best air flow in order to keep fresh and dry.
  • Dedicated speaker pockets for communication devices.

 

 

 

Retention System

  • The retention system used is the 'Double D-RING' in light alloy.

description:
KYT Jumpshot #1 Helmet

  • Certification: ECE , Indian BIS - ISI 

Specification:

Shell: Weight: Approx. 1350± 50 grams 

PROTECTIVE POLYSTYRENE

  • The protective polystyrene is produced in 2 sizes (M and L) to offer the best protection for all sizes and the best ergonomics. To obtain better ergonomics and a variable density. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the energy produced by the impact. Even if the bigger part of the energy created by the impact is absorbed by the external shell, thanks to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is determinant for the absorption of the residual power.

Inners:

  • Removable and washable Cheek pads and inner comfort liners.
  • The cheek pads and the internal comfort shell can be removed, washed and replaced. They are made of soft breathable bielastic fabric with synthetic fibers, that offer a high sweat absorption and keep fresh and dry. The cheek pads are easily removable, there are available cheek pads with different thickness.

Retention System:

  • Double D-Ring retention system: this reliable and tested double D-Ring system ensure stability, safety, and resistance.

Peak:

  • The peak has an elongated, protective profile and it’s easily adjustable to multiple positions without using tools.

VENTILATION

  • Internal polystyrene was studied to work in symbiosis with the air intake on the external shell. Particular channelings obtained on polystyrene, permit to air flow intake an optimal ventilation into the helmet and a quickly exhaust of the hot air.

description:
KYT R2R Pro Helmet

R2R Pro, full face Helmet of KYT, in which the research of the aerodynamics performance went on in the research of the best shape. The inner comfort joins the building technology to offer the best reliability and safety for the end user.

R2R Pro is designed and produced to obtain the best airflow inside the helmet and to offer the best comfort and aerodynamics values. The cooperation with aeronautical engineers, the use of innovative software and the use of the wind tunnel created a shape right for the aim of this helmet.

SPECIFICATION

SPORT TOURING - R2R PRO

  • Certification: ECE 22.06 , Indian ISI 

 

 

 

Shell

  • Shell produced in ADT-advanced, a mix of thermoplastic resins with high resistance to crashes. R2R shell is produced in two sizes: M and L.

 

 

 

Protective Polystyrene 

  • Internal polystyrene liner realized in two sizes (M and L) to obtain a better ergonomics and a variable density.
  • This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the energy produced by the impact.

Inners

name: KYT D City Plain Gloss White Helmet
description:
KYT D-City

D-City, the new KYT urban full face helmet in thermoplastic with ADT-Advanced technology; its fascinating shapes have been deeply studied for daily use in the short and medium trips without neglecting the stylistic and ergonomic aspects. The mechanisms of the visor and air intakes have been designed to give, at the same time, easy use and efficiency.

The high-quality removable interiors have been optimized to offer the best performance in terms of comfort and moisture flow inside the helmet. The visor guarantees wide visibility and aerodynamic protection while the retractable sun visor is a comfortable and indispensable sun protection system that can be easily activated with a cable button, elegantly integrated into the shape of the shell.

Equipped with internal sun visor for daytime use.

Homologation:
The helmet comes with ECE 22.06 and ISI certification.

 
 Shell: 
 The shell is made in two sizes (M and L) and is produced in ADT-Advance, a mix of           thermoplastic resins with a very high impact resistance.
   

Protective Polystyrene:

Internal polystyrene realized in two sizes (M and L) to obtain a better ergonomics and a variable density. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the energy produced by the impact. Even if the bigger part of the energy created by the impact is absorbed by the external shell, thanks to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is determinant for the absorption of the residual energy.

Visor:

The visor is made of injection-molded polycarbonate with anti-scratch treatment. The visor is easily removable, thanks to a brand new and practical mechanism that does not require the use of tools. The wide field of vision and the aerodynamic protection of the visor make D-City an ideal helmet for short and medium-range trips.


Pinlock:

D-City is ready for Antifog PINLOCK Max Vision 120 (NOT INCLUDED)
Note: (Pinlock antifog lens sold separately)

Sun Visor:

D-City is equipped with an internal sun visor with wide protection that can be easily operated with the left hand thanks to a sliding button positioned on the lower base of the shell.

Ventilation:

Particular channelings obtained on polystyrene, allow to work in symbiosis with the several air  intakes an optimal ventilation into the helmet and a quickly exhaust of the hot air. 

Inners:

They are made of soft breathable bielastic fabric with synthetic fibers, that offer high sweat absorption and keep fresh and dry. Crown padding and cheek pads are easily removable. The cheek pads are predisposed for a bluetooth headset.


Retention System:

QRM-micrometric The retention system is equipped of micrometric buckle.

  • Visor: Clear scratch resistant visor and inner sun visor

  • Retention System: Polyestere tape 24 mm – micrometric buckle

name: KYT TT Revo Leopard India Edition Gloss Helmet
description:
KYT TT Revo Helmet

TT-Revo, the KYT full face helmet whose shell is produced in ADT-advanced thermoplastic, a mix of thermoplastic resins with high resistance to crashes.
Its captivating and extreme shapes have been studied in the wind tunnel, to achieve the best performances without neglecting style and ergonomic.
The fine visor mechanism has been designed to offer practicality and efficiency at the same time. Precious inners have been optimized to offer the best performance for comfort and outflow of the air.
The collaboration with aeronautics engineer, the use of special software and the wind tunnel gave life to this innovative helmet: strong, comfortable and performing. TT-Revo, the racing helmet to stand out every day.

Homologation:
The helmet comes with ECE 22.06 and ISI certification.

Shell:

Shell is made in three sizes (S, M and L), ADT-advanced thermoplastic, a mix of thermoplastic resins with high resistance to crashes.

Protective Polystyrene:

Internal polystyrene realized in three sizes (XS, M and L) to obtain a better ergonomics and a variable density. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the energy produced by the impact. Even if the bigger part of the energy created by the impact is absorbed by the external shell, thanks to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is determinant for the absorption of the residual energy.

Visor:

 The visor is made of polycarbonate, with anti-scratch treatment. The new ratchet allows the visor removal without tools. TT-Revo has a brand new lock system (PAT PEND) to fix the visor during the riding in the close position.

  

Pinlock: TT Revo is MAX PINLOCK 70 ready.
Note: Pinlock Antifog Lens NOT INCLUDED

Ventilation :

Particular channelings obtained on polystyrene allow to work in symbiosis with the several air intakes to obtain an optimal ventilation into the helmet and a quickly exhaust of the hot air. TT Revo has five air intakes on the front and four air extractors under the aerodynamics spoiler.

Inners:

They are made of soft breathable bi-elastic fabric with synthetic fibers, that offer a high sweat absorption and keep fresh and dry. The cheek pads are easily removable and they are available with different thickness.

Retention System:
The retention system is equipped of Double D Rings.

name: KYT KX1 RACE GP Bastianini Indonesia Replica 2023 with Sponsor Matt Helmet
description:
KYT KX1 RACE GP Helmet

Overview:

Get ready to experience the ultimate in motorcycle racing with the brand new KYT KX-1 Race GP helmet!
Designed and developed in Italy by most advanced digital tools, the KYT helmet has undergone rigorous testing by Ducati Corse Factory rider Enea Bastianini to ensure its top-of-the-line performance.
It boasts improved aerodynamics for a smoother ride and professional race performance, thanks to over three years of wind tunnel and track tests to optimize aerodynamics in various riding positions (even when cornering), enhanced peripheral field of view (92 deg and 210 deg) for a safer journey, and it meets FIM Standard (the top of the motorcycle helmet standards).
But that’s not all – KX-1 RACE GP also features a liner that has been expertly crafted for maximum comfort in all conditions. And to top it all off, it has an anti-bacterial coating to keep riders healthy and hygienic. This helmet will be used in the highly acclaimed MotoGP series and is expected to be a hit with riders everywhere.

Don’t miss out on this opportunity to upgrade your ride performance and take your motorcycle experience to the next level.

The KX-1 RACE helmet is used in MotoGP™ and continues to be adopted by world-class racers everywhere.

Shell:
The outer shell is made of Tri-Fiber composite, a mix of kevlar, carbon and fiber glass, to ensure a better impact resistance and lighter weight.

The shell is made of TRICOMPOSITE fiber, a new composite that allows to obtain a lighter but at the same time harder and more protective shell. The new composite is a mixture of carbon with different weight/breaking loads linked up with aramid resins that ensure a light but much more resistant to impacts shell. To satisfy even the most exigent customers, KX-1 RACE GP is produced in three different shells: S, M and L.


Protective Polystyrene:

Internal polystyrene liner is realized in four sizes (S, M, L and XL) to obtain a better ergonomics and a variable density. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the power produced by the impact. Even if the bigger part of the energy created by the impact is absorbed by the external shell, thanks to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is crucial for the absorption of the residual power. A different density of the polystyrene allows to optimize the mechanical performance of the shell-polystyrene, ensuring the maximum level of absorption in all areas of the helmet.

Visor:

The visor is PC injected, antiscratch, with variable thickness. Easy to remove thanks to a system that doesn’t require the use of any tool. The release lever is made of a particular metal alloy that gives greater solidity to the assembly. The visor is also equipped with a locking mechanism “Racing Lock System” in metal alloy. The mechanism reduces the possibility of detachment in case of crash. KX-1 RACE GP is prepared for racing tear off.

Pinlock:

KX-1 RACE GP is prepared and ready for PINLOCK® MAX VISION 120, the most performing antifog system in the market.
 
NOTE: Pinlock Antifog Lens NOT INCLUDED

Ventilation:

It is during the hottest Grands Prix that the most is asked to the rider, requiring concentration and endurance. Being able to count on efficient ventilation makes all the difference. KX-1 RACE GP spots seven air intake ducts which work in conjunction with a neatly integrated channel system, guaranteeing excellent airflow inside the helmet. The hot air extraction is a marvel of aerodynamics: two submerged air extractors, working together with the rear spoiler, create a Venturi effect over the exhaust ports, drawing out the hot air.

Inners :

The cheek pads and the internal comfort liners can be removed, washed and replaced. They are made of precious fabric with specific fibers that offer the following features: •  Send away sweat from the head •  Keep fresh and dry •  Light fabric, soft and breathable Cheek pads are customizable and easily removable in case of emergency thanks to the quick release system. KX-1 RACE GP is prepared for the camel-bag system.



 

Retention System:

The chin is provided with DRING retention system enabling an easy release of the retain system.

 

 

Technical Specifications:

  • Homologations: ECE 22-06 , FIM , ISI
  • Commercial Name:  KYT KX-1 RACE GP  
  • Description: Full face helmet 
  • Materials shell: Tricomposite (carbon, fiberglass, aramidic)
  • Polystyrene: Polystyrene in four sizes  (S, M, L, XL)
  • Visor: Anti-scratch with  uv 380 ray filters
  • Antifog System: Pinlock Max Vision 120 
  • Retention System: DD ring 
  • Approx. Weight: 1400 gr ±50 in size M & 1500 gr ±50 in size L
  • Nr. shell: 3
  • Nr. polystyrene: 4

It boasts improved aerodynamics for a smoother ride and professional race performance, thanks to over three years of wind tunnel and track tests to optimize aerodynamics in various riding positions (even when cornering), enhanced peripheral field of view (92 deg and 210 deg) for a safer journey, and it meets FIM Standard (the top of the motorcycle helmet standards).
But that’s not all – KX-1 RACE GP also features a liner that has been expertly crafted for maximum comfort in all conditions. And to top it all off, it has an anti-bacterial coating to keep riders healthy and hygienic. This helmet will be used in the highly acclaimed MotoGP series and is expected to be a hit with riders everywhere.

Don’t miss out on this opportunity to upgrade your ride performance and take your motorcycle experience to the next level.

The KX-1 RACE helmet is used in MotoGP™ and continues to be adopted by world-class racers everywhere.

Shell:
The outer shell is made of Tri-Fiber composite, a mix of kevlar, carbon and fiber glass, to ensure a better impact resistance and lighter weight.

The shell is made of TRICOMPOSITE fiber, a new composite that allows to obtain a lighter but at the same time harder and more protective shell. The new composite is a mixture of carbon with different weight/breaking loads linked up with aramid resins that ensure a light but much more resistant to impacts shell. To satisfy even the most exigent customers, KX-1 RACE GP is produced in three different shells: S, M and L.


Protective Polystyrene:

Internal polystyrene liner is realized in four sizes (S, M, L and XL) to obtain a better ergonomics and a variable density. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the power produced by the impact. Even if the bigger part of the energy created by the impact is absorbed by the external shell, thanks to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is crucial for the absorption of the residual power. A different density of the polystyrene allows to optimize the mechanical performance of the shell-polystyrene, ensuring the maximum level of absorption in all areas of the helmet.

Visor:

The visor is PC injected, antiscratch, with variable thickness. Easy to remove thanks to a system that doesn’t require the use of any tool. The release lever is made of a particular metal alloy that gives greater solidity to the assembly. The visor is also equipped with a locking mechanism “Racing Lock System” in metal alloy. The mechanism reduces the possibility of detachment in case of crash. KX-1 RACE GP is prepared for racing tear off.

Pinlock:

KX-1 RACE GP is prepared and ready for PINLOCK® MAX VISION 120, the most performing antifog system in the market.
 
NOTE: Pinlock Antifog Lens NOT INCLUDED

Ventilation:

It is during the hottest Grands Prix that the most is asked to the rider, requiring concentration and endurance. Being able to count on efficient ventilation makes all the difference. KX-1 RACE GP spots seven air intake ducts which work in conjunction with a neatly integrated channel system, guaranteeing excellent airflow inside the helmet. The hot air extraction is a marvel of aerodynamics: two submerged air extractors, working together with the rear spoiler, create a Venturi effect over the exhaust ports, drawing out the hot air.

Inners :

The cheek pads and the internal comfort liners can be removed, washed and replaced. They are made of precious fabric with specific fibers that offer the following features: •  Send away sweat from the head •  Keep fresh and dry •  Light fabric, soft and breathable Cheek pads are customizable and easily removable in case of emergency thanks to the quick release system. KX-1 RACE GP is prepared for the camel-bag system.



 

Retention System:

The chin is provided with DRING retention system enabling an easy release of the retain system.

name: KYT NZ Race Lorenzo Savadori Replica Gloss Helmet
description:
KYT NZ Race Helmet

NZ-RACE, the KYT full-face helmet in tricomposite material derived from Kyt’s experience in the Racing world.

The shapes have been deeply studied, through fluid dynamic software and through repeated sessions in the wind tunnel, as well as on the track with the KYT riders, to achieve the best performance in terms of aerodynamics, ventilation and comfort, while at the same time enhancing the stylistic aspect characterized, as tradition, by dynamic streamlined shapes.

In particular, the spoiler has been carefully designed to achieve outstanding performance in terms of both aerodynamics and comfort.

The ventilation has also been meticulously optimized to ensure an efficient diffusion of fresh air inside the helmet and to offer, in symbiosis with the fine interior, the outflow of moisture inside the helmet. The visor is in optical class 1 and guarantees a wide peripheral and vertical field of vision, 210° and 90° respectively; anti-scratch treatment, Pinlock® Max Vision 70 anti-fog lens and reference lightness complete top-level equipment suitable for both professional use on the track and for pure fun on the road.

SPECIFICATION

SPORT TOURING - NZ Race

  • Certification: ECE 22.06 , Indian ISI 




Shell

  • The shell is made in two sizes (M and L) and it is made of Tri-Fiber composite, a mix of kevlar, carbon and fiber glass, to ensure a better impact resistance and lighter weight.





Protective Polystyrene 

  • The internal polystyrene is made of 3 different sizes to obtain the best ergonomics with different thickness. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the impact force generated by an impact.
  • Although most of the energy due to an impact is absorbed by the outer protective shell due to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is decisive for the absorption of residual energy.

Visor

  • The visor is made of polycarbonate with different thickness in optical class 1 and anti scratch treatment.
  • The visor is easily removable, thanks to a practical mechanism that doesn’t require any tool.
  • Pinlock Max Vision 70 Ready (Note: Lens not included with helmet) Buy Now







Ventilation

  • The internal polystyrene is studied to work in symbiosis with 3 front air intakes on the shell. Special channels on the EPS allow a non-stop air flow, ensuring a perfect ventilation inside the helmet and a rapid exhaust of the hot air through the extractors on the back, under the aerodynamic spoiler.

Inners 

  • Inners are removable and washable, in fine and soft fabrics made of fiber that, together with particular sponges, eases the air flow, maintaining dry and fresh the part in contact with the face.
  • Cheeck pads are ready for Bluetooth headphone, have an emergency system to quickly remove them in case of needs and they have “glasses wearable” predisposition.

 



Retention System

  • The retention system used is the 'Double D-RING' in light alloy.

name: KYT R2R Pro Concept Matt Black Yellow Helmet
description:
KYT R2R Pro Helmet

R2R Pro, full face Helmet of KYT, in which the research of the aerodynamics performance went on in the research of the best shape. The inner comfort joins the building technology to offer the best reliability and safety for the end user.

R2R Pro is designed and produced to obtain the best airflow inside the helmet and to offer the best comfort and aerodynamics values. The cooperation with aeronautical engineers, the use of innovative software and the use of the wind tunnel created a shape right for the aim of this helmet.

SPECIFICATION

SPORT TOURING - R2R PRO

  • Certification: ECE 22.06 , Indian ISI 

 

 

 

Shell

  • Shell produced in ADT-advanced, a mix of thermoplastic resins with high resistance to crashes. R2R shell is produced in two sizes: M and L.

 

 

 

Protective Polystyrene 

  • Internal polystyrene liner realized in two sizes (M and L) to obtain a better ergonomics and a variable density.
  • This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the energy produced by the impact.

Visor

  • The visor of R2R is PC injected, scratch resistant, optic in class 1 with variable thickness combined with Pinlock Max Vision ready and Sun Visor.
  • The hooks and rotation system allows the visor removal without tools.
  • Note:
    Pinlock 70 Antifog lens available separately (OPTIONAL) - BUY NOW


 

 

  

 

 

Ventilation

  • Internal Polystyrene liner was studied to work in symbiosis with the air intake on the external shell. Particular channelings, obtained on polystyrene, allow to air flow intake an optimal ventilation into the helmet and a quickly exhaust of the hot air.

Inners 

  • The cheek pads and the internal comfort shell can be removed, washed and replaced. They are made of precious bielastic fabric with specific fibers coupled with sponges with open cells for the best air flow in order to keep fresh and dry.
  • Dedicated speaker pockets for communication devices.

 

 

 

Retention System

  • The retention system used is the 'Double D-RING' in light alloy.

 

 

 

Weight

  • Weight (approx.) gr 1600 ± 50

What's included in the Box

  • Helmet Cloth Bag x 1pc
  • User manual x 1pc

name: KYT NZ Race Carbon Stride Gloss Black Red White Helmet
description:
KYT NZ Race Helmet

NZ-RACE, the KYT full-face helmet in tricomposite material derived from Kyt’s experience in the Racing world.

The shapes have been deeply studied, through fluid dynamic software and through repeated sessions in the wind tunnel, as well as on the track with the KYT riders, to achieve the best performance in terms of aerodynamics, ventilation and comfort, while at the same time enhancing the stylistic aspect characterized, as tradition, by dynamic streamlined shapes.

In particular, the spoiler has been carefully designed to achieve outstanding performance in terms of both aerodynamics and comfort.

The ventilation has also been meticulously optimized to ensure an efficient diffusion of fresh air inside the helmet and to offer, in symbiosis with the fine interior, the outflow of moisture inside the helmet. The visor is in optical class 1 and guarantees a wide peripheral and vertical field of vision, 210° and 90° respectively; anti-scratch treatment, Pinlock® Max Vision 70 anti-fog lens and reference lightness complete top-level equipment suitable for both professional use on the track and for pure fun on the road.

SPECIFICATION

SPORT TOURING - NZ Race

  • Certification: ECE 22.06 , Indian ISI 

 

 

 

Shell

  • The shell is made in two sizes (M and L) and it is made of Tri-Fiber composite, a mix of kevlar, carbon and fiber glass, to ensure a better impact resistance and lighter weight.



 

 

Protective Polystyrene 

  • The internal polystyrene is made of 3 different sizes to obtain the best ergonomics with different thickness. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the impact force generated by an impact.
  • Although most of the energy due to an impact is absorbed by the outer protective shell due to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is decisive for the absorption of residual energy.

Visor

  • The visor is made of polycarbonate with different thickness in optical class 1 and anti scratch treatment.
  • The visor is easily removable, thanks to a practical mechanism that doesn’t require any tool.
  • Pinlock Max Vision 70 Ready (Note: Lens not included with helmet) Buy Now


 

 


 

 

Ventilation

  • The internal polystyrene is studied to work in symbiosis with 3 front air intakes on the shell. Special channels on the EPS allow a non-stop air flow, ensuring a perfect ventilation inside the helmet and a rapid exhaust of the hot air through the extractors on the back, under the aerodynamic spoiler.

Inners 

  • Inners are removable and washable, in fine and soft fabrics made of fiber that, together with particular sponges, eases the air flow, maintaining dry and fresh the part in contact with the face.
  • Cheeck pads are ready for Bluetooth headphone, have an emergency system to quickly remove them in case of needs and they have “glasses wearable” predisposition.

 

 

 

Retention System

  • The retention system used is the 'Double D-RING' in light alloy.

 

 

 

Weight

  • Weight (approx.) gr 1400 ± 50

  • Helmet Cloth Bag x 1pc
  • User manual x 1pc

name: KYT D City Lucent Matt Black Silver Helmet
description:
KYT D-City

D-City, the new KYT urban full face helmet in thermoplastic with ADT-Advanced technology; its fascinating shapes have been deeply studied for daily use in the short and medium trips without neglecting the stylistic and ergonomic aspects. The mechanisms of the visor and air intakes have been designed to give, at the same time, easy use and efficiency.

The high-quality removable interiors have been optimized to offer the best performance in terms of comfort and moisture flow inside the helmet. The visor guarantees wide visibility and aerodynamic protection while the retractable sun visor is a comfortable and indispensable sun protection system that can be easily activated with a cable button, elegantly integrated into the shape of the shell.

Equipped with internal sun visor for daytime use.

Homologation:
The helmet comes with ECE 22.06 and ISI certification.

 
 Shell: 
 The shell is made in two sizes (M and L) and is produced in ADT-Advance, a mix of           thermoplastic resins with a very high impact resistance.
   

Protective Polystyrene:

Internal polystyrene realized in two sizes (M and L) to obtain a better ergonomics and a variable density. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the energy produced by the impact. Even if the bigger part of the energy created by the impact is absorbed by the external shell, thanks to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is determinant for the absorption of the residual energy.

Visor:

The visor is made of injection-molded polycarbonate with anti-scratch treatment. The visor is easily removable, thanks to a brand new and practical mechanism that does not require the use of tools. The wide field of vision and the aerodynamic protection of the visor make D-City an ideal helmet for short and medium-range trips.


Pinlock:

D-City is ready for Antifog PINLOCK Max Vision 120 (NOT INCLUDED)
Note: (Pinlock antifog lens sold separately)

Sun Visor:

D-City is equipped with an internal sun visor with wide protection that can be easily operated with the left hand thanks to a sliding button positioned on the lower base of the shell.

Ventilation:

Particular channelings obtained on polystyrene, allow to work in symbiosis with the several air  intakes an optimal ventilation into the helmet and a quickly exhaust of the hot air. 

Inners:

They are made of soft breathable bielastic fabric with synthetic fibers, that offer high sweat absorption and keep fresh and dry. Crown padding and cheek pads are easily removable. The cheek pads are predisposed for a bluetooth headset.


Retention System:

QRM-micrometric The retention system is equipped of micrometric buckle.


Technical Specification:

  • Homologations:  ECE 22-06
  • Commercial Name:  KYT  D-CITY 
  • Description: Open face protective helmet
  • Materials shell: Thermoplastic – advanced
  • Polystyrene: Protective polystyrene (M and L)
  • Visor: Clear scratch resistant visor and inner sun visor
  • Antifog: Pinlock 120 Ready 
    Note: Pinlock Antifog Lens NOT INCLUDED
  • Retention System: Polyestere tape 24 mm – micrometric buckle
  • Approx weight:  1350 ± 50 in shell Large

  • Nr. Polystyrene: 2

KYT NZ Race Bastianini 2022 Replica

NZ-RACE, the KYT full-face helmet in tri composite material derived from Kyt’s experience in the Racing world.

The shapes have been deeply studied, through fluid dynamic software and through repeated sessions in the wind tunnel, as well as on the track with the KYT riders, to achieve the best performance in terms of aerodynamics, ventilation and comfort, while at the same time enhancing the stylistic aspect characterized, as tradition, by dynamic streamlined shapes.

In particular, the spoiler has been carefully designed to achieve outstanding performance in terms of both aerodynamics and comfort.

The ventilation has also been meticulously optimized to ensure an efficient diffusion of fresh air inside the helmet and to offer, in symbiosis with the fine interior, the outflow of moisture inside the helmet. The visor is in optical class 1 and guarantees a wide peripheral and vertical field of vision, 210° and 90° respectively; anti-scratch treatment, Pinlock® Max Vision 70 anti-fog lens and reference lightness complete top-level equipment suitable for both professional use on the track and for pure fun on the road.

Specification:

Certification: ECE 22.06, Indian BIS ISI

SHELL

  • Tri-Fiber Composite
  • Weight (approx.) 1400± 50 grams
  • Two-s Shell
  • Wind Tunnel Tested

The shell is made in two sizes (M and L) and it is made of Tri-Fiber composite, a mix of kevlar, carbon and fiber glass, to ensure a better impact resistance and lighter weight.

PROTECTIVE POLYSTYRENE

  • The internal polystyrene is made of 3 different sizes to obtain the best ergonomics with different thickness. This characteristic allows a gradual and progressive absorption of the impact force generated by an impact.
  • Although most of the energy due to an impact is absorbed by the outer protective shell due to its deformation, the role of polystyrene is decisive for the absorption of residual energy.

VISOR

  • Optical Visor Class 1
  • UV 380 Full Vision
  • Anti fog R-Vision (Pinlock 70 Ready) 
  • Anti Scratch

PINLOCK

VENTILATION

  • The internal polystyrene is studied to work in symbiosis with 3 front air intakes on the shell. Special channels on the EPS allow a non-stop air flow, ensuring a perfect ventilation inside the helmet and a rapid exhaust of the hot air through the extractors on the back, under the aerodynamic spoiler.

INNERS

  • Rem-Pad Removable and washable
  • Wearable Glasses
  • Earpad Speaker House for communication systems
  • Emergency release cheekpads

Inners are removable and washable, in fine and soft fabrics made of fiber that, together with particular sponges, eases the air flow, maintaining dry and fresh the part in contact with the face. Cheek pads are ready for Bluetooth headphone, have an emergency system to quickly remove them in case of needs and they have “glasses wearable” predisposition.

RETENTION SYSTEM

  • Double D-RING

TORNADO - CRASH GUARD v2.0 For Suzuki V-STROM SX 250
description:
Whether it’s the open highway or the daily city grind, your Suzuki V-Strom SX 250 deserves protection that works as hard as you do. Moto Torque’s Premium Crash Guard delivers uncompromising durability, ensuring your ride stays secure no matter where the road takes you.

Forged from 25mm Cold Rolled (CR) mild steel tubes with reinforced wall thicknesses of 1.6mm and 2mm, this crash guard is built to handle both long-distance touring and everyday urban obstacles, absorbing shocks so your V-Strom SX 250 remains unshaken.

At the heart of this protection system is the high-impact nylon slider, strategically engineered to take the initial force of an impact. Acting as the first line of defense, it absorbs and disperses shock energy before it reaches the bike’s body, effectively safeguarding the engine, frame, and essential components. This means that even in unexpected falls or collisions, the integrity of your V-Strom SX 250’s vital parts remains uncompromised, allowing you to ride with complete peace of mind.

With three precisely positioned mounting points, this crash guard ensures structural integrity while evenly dispersing impact forces—protecting your V-Strom SX 250 without unnecessary strain on its frame. Secured with high-grade Stainless Steel 304 nuts and bolts, it delivers unmatched reliability for every mile ahead.

Moto Torque’s crash guard isn’t just an accessory—it’s an investment in confidence, allowing you to tackle every challenge knowing your V-Strom SX 250 is equipped for the unexpected.

So wherever your next ride takes you—the city streets or the open road—trust Moto Torque to keep your V-Strom SX 250 protected, stylish, and ready for adventure.


WARRANTY

6 Months Paint/Powder Coating & welding.

Lifetime warranty on Bolts & Nuts.

Compatible For SUZUKI V-STORM SX250

 

COMES WITH "DO IT YOURSELF" FITMENT GUIDE.

name: BIG SLIDERS+BOLTS (SET)
description:
Moto Torque Big Sliders with Bolts (Set)

Designed to act as the first line of defence, Moto Torque Big Sliders help absorb and distribute impact forces during a fall or crash. By taking the initial impact, they help minimize the transfer of force to the crash guard and motorcycle frame, reducing stress on critical mounting points and helping preserve the integrity of the protection system.

Key Features

  • Acts as the first point of contact during a fall or crash
  • Helps reduce impact transfer to the crash guard and motorcycle frame
  • Manufactured from durable high-grade polypropylene
  • Large-profile design for enhanced impact absorption
  • Strong, lightweight, and weather-resistant construction
  • Designed specifically for Moto Torque Crash Guards
  • Includes mounting bolts for secure installation

Compatibility

Compatible only with Moto Torque Crash Guards.

What's Included

  • 2 x Big Sliders
  • 2 x Mounting Bolts

Installation

Direct-fit design for quick and hassle-free installation using standard tools.

Ride Protected

Engineered to work seamlessly with Moto Torque Crash Guards, these Big Sliders provide an additional layer of protection by absorbing impacts before they reach the crash guard and frame, helping keep your motorcycle protected during unexpected drops and mishaps.
