description:
Introducing Moto Torque's Premium Crash Guard for Dominar 400 – The perfect blend of strength, protection, and style.

Engineered with precision, built with robust 25mm mild steel tubes, designed to deliver unmatched impact resistance and superior rigidity. With wall thicknesses of 1.6mm and 2mm, it’s built to endure even the toughest challenges, safeguarding your ride with ease. The use of Cold Rolled (CR) tube ensures exceptional strength, providing high durability that can withstand abrasion and harsh conditions, so you’re always ready for the road or off-road ahead.

What sets this crash guard apart is its innovative slider feature. A nylon slider designed to absorb the initial impact during a crash or a fall, the sliders act as the first line of defense, reducing the force that reaches the frame of your motorcycle. This not only protects your bike from damage but also enhances safety in the event of a fall.

It also comes with 3 strong mounting points that make sure the impact is equally distributed and no harm is caused to the frame or the chassis.

Comes with high-quality Stainless Steel 304-grade nuts and bolts, ensuring a sleek, durable finish. And with a lifetime warranty on all nuts and bolts, you can trust in long-lasting reliability.

Protect your Dominar 400 in style with a crash guard engineered to deliver superior impact absorption and resilience, ride after ride.

At MOTO TORQUE, we're dedicated to giving you the protection, quality, and peace of mind you deserve on every ride.

name: Motul P3 Tyre Repair (300 ml)
description:
TYPE OF USE

All motorcycle tyres with or without inner tubes.

PERFORMANCE

  • Repairs and reinflates tyres immediately without removal or tools.
  • Latex based: Does not damage the tyre or the tube.
  • The MOTUL TYRE REPAIR container is pressurized and permits all types of tyres to be reinflated, for tyres over 15", a second spray might be necessary.
  • Enables several hundred kilometers to be covered before repairing using the traditional methods.
  • Shock-resistant aluminium spray.

RECOMMENDATIONS

  • Remove if possible the object which caused the puncture.
  • Position the tyre valve at the top.
  • Completely deflate the tyre.
  • Shake vigorously MOTUL TYRE REPAIR.
  • In cold weather, reheat it in your hands or near the engine.
  • Clean the screw on the valve.
  • Screw on the MOTUL TYRE REPAIR connector. .
  • Remove the protection capsule.
  • Position the spray upside down.
  • Press the button until the tyre is totally reinflated.
  • Drive immediately for 10 to 20 km at moderate speed so that the product is evenly distributed.
  • Control the pressure as soon as possible and during the following days and adjust it.
  • You can confidently drive several hundred kilometres before repairing the tyre in the traditional way.

SECURITY

  • Injected & Welded Dual-density rubber sole
  • Moulded EVA Insole with Antimicrobial treatment

Features

  • Broad Calf Compatibility ensures a comfortable and secure fit for a range of riders, regardless of their calf size or shape.
  • Stretch Panels at rear for Flexibility & Natural Movement On & Off Road
  • Adjustable VELCRO® Brand Closure

      Raida Trailcraft MX Boots are purpose-built for off-road, motocross, and ADV riders who demand maximum protection and durability in aggressive riding conditions. While they’re built tough, proper usage and care are essential for long-lasting performance.

      What’s Covered:

      • Manufacturing defects in stitching, sole bonding, or buckles
      • Premature failure of Velcro, straps, or closure systems
      • Material separation under normal riding use
      • Faulty shank, footbed, or internal padding due to manufacturing issues

      If a valid manufacturing defect is confirmed, Raida will repair or replace the boots at its sole discretion subject to their approval.

      What’s Not Covered:

      • Damage from crashes, falls, or impact during off-road use (these are protective, not indestructible)
      • Wear and tear from normal or aggressive riding
      • Sole wear from gear shifting, walking, or footpegs
      • Damage caused by water immersion, pressure washing, or drying under direct heat
      • Buckle breakage due to over-tightening or forceful handling
      • Leather or PU discoloration, fading, or wrinkling due to sun, water, or sweat
      • Mold or odor caused by storing boots when damp
      • Improper fit, comfort issues, or stiffness after use (break-in time varies by rider)
      • Unauthorized modifications or third-party repairs

      Note: These boots are NOT waterproof. Exposure to water, slush, or river crossings may lead to moisture ingress. This will not be considered a defect.

name: Carbon Brake Pads For Zontes 350T Adventure (2023 Onwards) - Rear - CFB041 - 1 Set
description:
CRANK1 CARBON BRAKE SERIES

The CRANK1 Carbon Brake Series is one of the most preferred choices, loved by track racers and widely used in MotoGP.
It delivers exceptional stopping power with a unique formulation made from more than 20 types of friction materials, including high-quality carbon compounds and DuPont Kevlar fiber.

It offers superior high-temperature resistance and excellent heat dissipation, resulting in minimal brake fade. The pads can withstand temperatures of up to 500°C while maintaining consistent performance.

CRANK1 Carbon Series is suitable for all weather and rough road conditions, providing reliable and confident braking performance.

The special surface treatment promotes efficient heat dissipation, while its unique bonding technology ensures an indestructible steel backing plate with 30% stronger bonding strength compared to conventional brake pads — preventing separation even under extreme braking conditions.

The unique internal microporous structure and fiber arrangement reduce noise, improve disc friendliness, and maintain thermal balance, enhancing braking comfort, stability, and overall performance.

CARBON BRAKE SERIES – FEATURES

Key Benefits:

  1. Improved Stopping Power:

The CRANK1 Carbon Brake Series is one of the most preferred choices, loved by track racers and widely used in MotoGP.
It delivers exceptional stopping power with a unique formulation made from more than 20 types of friction materials, including high-quality carbon compounds and DuPont Kevlar fiber.

It offers superior high-temperature resistance and excellent heat dissipation, resulting in minimal brake fade. The pads can withstand temperatures of up to 500°C while maintaining consistent performance.

CRANK1 Carbon Series is suitable for all weather and rough road conditions, providing reliable and confident braking performance.

The special surface treatment promotes efficient heat dissipation, while its unique bonding technology ensures an indestructible steel backing plate with 30% stronger bonding strength compared to conventional brake pads — preventing separation even under extreme braking conditions.

The unique internal microporous structure and fiber arrangement reduce noise, improve disc friendliness, and maintain thermal balance, enhancing braking comfort, stability, and overall performance.

CARBON BRAKE SERIES – FEATURES

Key Benefits:

  1. Improved Stopping Power:
    CRANK1 Carbon brake pads deliver excellent friction and efficient heat dissipation.

  2. Reduced Brake Fade:
    Designed to resist heat buildup, ensuring consistent braking performance.

  3. Increased Durability:
    More resistant to wear and tear compared to conventional brake pads.

  4. Lightweight Construction:
    Lighter than traditional brake pads, improving overall braking response.

  5. Corrosion Resistance:
    Less prone to corrosion, increasing longevity and reliability.

Key Construction Features:

  1. Carbon Fiber Compound:
    A blend of carbon fibers and advanced materials for enhanced friction and heat dissipation.

  2. Steel or Titanium Backing Plate:
    Provides added strength and durability.

  3. Ceramic or Kevlar Reinforcement:
    Enhances friction stability and heat resistance.

By upgrading to CRANK1 Carbon Brake Pads, you enhance your motorcycle’s braking performance, safety, and riding comfort.
This series is suitable for daily commuting, long-distance riding, and performance applications, offering a smooth and confident riding experience.

name: Sintered Brake Pads For Royal Enfield Classic 350/500 (2016 Onwards) - Front - CB181 - 1 Set
description:
CRANK1 Sintered Brake Pads are commonly used in superbikes. They are known for their durability, high performance, and ability to handle extreme riding conditions. Below are some key features and benefits of the CRANK1 Sintered Series.

HIGH HEAT TOLERANCE:

CRANK1 sintered brake pads excel in high-temperature conditions, making them suitable for aggressive riding, track use, or challenging terrains. They maintain consistent performance even under heavy braking, helping to prevent brake fade.

EXCELLENT STOPPING POWER:

CRANK1 sintered pads offer strong and consistent stopping power, making them ideal for riders who demand precise control and responsiveness from their brakes. This is especially important in situations that require quick stops.

LONGER LIFESPAN:

Due to their robust construction, CRANK1 sintered pads typically have a longer lifespan than organic alternatives. This results in fewer replacements and reduced maintenance costs over time.

VERSATILITY:

CRANK1 sintered pads perform well in various weather conditions, including wet or muddy environments. They maintain reliable stopping power even when wet.

LESS BRAKE FADE:

CRANK1 sintered pads help minimize brake fade, even under extreme riding conditions.

SUITABLE FOR TOURING:

CRANK1 sintered pads are often recommended for motorcycles carrying heavy loads, such as touring bikes or those used for long-distance travel. Their durability and heat resistance make them ideal for such applications.

Please refer to the image for size and specifications.

Technical Specifications:

• Specific pressure: P < 5.1 MPa
• Sliding speed: V < 30 m/s
• Constant maximum temperature: 680°C
• Short-term maximum temperature: 830°C

FEATURES:

• Very high static friction coefficient
• Low abrasive interaction with the brake rotor material
• Special braking surface modification
• Stainless-steel heat shield on the backing plate for thermal insulation
• Minimal difference in braking performance between dry and wet conditions
• High abrasion resistance
• High braking power up to 660°C (maximum 830°C)
• The sintered friction material is soldered to a copper-coated backing plate, virtually eliminating the risk of separation (a common issue with organic materials)

ALLTERRA X-ACES is the MX helmet range of SMK. Made of 2 outer injected EIRT shells for optimized safety and comfortable fitting, it has been conceived by the world’s most famous MX experts for off road lovers!

It features an easily removable and adjustable peak. With the washable and removable hypoallergenic liner equipped with anti-moisture management & antistatic properties you are always good to go. The channeled ventilation system with multiple air vents and air exhausts provides maximum comfort to the rider. The extra wide eye opening allows hosting mx goggles in a firm way during x-riding which will allow an excellent view of the track. The SMK Allterra is available with strong graphics as well as in solid colors.

Technical Specification:

  • Homologation: ECE 22-06, DOT FMVSS No. 218 & ISI 4151
  • 2 shell sizes 
  • Injected EIRT shell
  • Extremely Lightweight : 1350 ± 50 grams
  • Easily removable and adjustable peak
  • Double D Rings locking system for maximum safety on road and off road.
  • Extra wide eye-opening allows firmly hosting most mx goggles

  • Proudly Made in India

Inner:

  • Vibrant fabric colors
  • Breathable, hypoallergenic liners
  • Fully removable and washable.
  • Resil coated comfort liner.
  • Antistatic & Moisture management Fabric

Air Ventilation:

name: SMK Nova Super Gloss Grey Red White (GL631) Helmet
description:
NOVA SUPER, the ultimate full-face helmet designed for riders who seek performance, comfort, and style in every journey features a sleek and modern shape that combines sporty flair with elegance-perfect for your everyday adventures.

It comes with a removable and washable inner liner to keep you feeling fresh no matter the distance. The eyeglass-friendly harness ensures a secure and safe fit for all riders, while the one-touch visor, optically corrected for clarity, provides an ultra-wide field of vision and is Pinlock@ 30 ready to tackle any weather.

NOVA’s superior ventilation system, equipped with wind protector and a nose deflector, channels air efficiently to keep you cool and comfortable on the go. name: SMK Allterra Bulldozer White Blue Red Gloss (GL153) Helmet
description:
ALLTERRA BULLDOZER is the MX helmet range of SMK. Made of 2 outer injected EIRT shells for optimized safety and comfortable fitting, it has been conceived by the world’s most famous MX experts for off road lovers!

It features an easily removable and adjustable peak. With the washable and removable hypoallergenic liner equipped with anti-moisture management & antistatic properties you are always good to go. The channeled ventilation system with multiple air vents and air exhausts provides maximum comfort to the rider. The extra wide eye opening allows hosting mx goggles in a firm way during x-riding which will allow an excellent view of the track. The SMK Allterra is available with strong graphics as well as in solid colors.

name: SMK Spare Pinlock 70 Max Vision Lens for Gullwing Helmets
description:
Compatibility Note:

Only suitable for SMK Gullwing Modular Helmets with 100% Max Vision (Pinlock 70) compatible face shields.

  • Consists of 1 unit of Pinlock 70 Lens only for SMK Gullwing Helmet
  • Pinlock 70 Visor NOT included
  • This antifog lens will fit only on SMK Gullwing Pinlock 70 Ready visor

Overview:

  • The 100% Max Vision Pinlock 70 fog resistant insert lens is a premium solution for SMK helmets.
  • This lens has become the benchmark for fog resistant performance that is most commonly used by riders across the world.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and, therefore the surface basically dry when used.
  • The insert has a silicone seal that creates a double shield system.

Specification:

  • Double shield system created by a silicon seal
  • Dry hydrofilic technology
  • Easy to clean and install
  • Interchangeable with other Pinlock lenses
  • 100% Max Vision® technology provides a clear view throughout the complete eye port of the shield

Overview:

  • The Pinlock 70 is a premium fog resistant solution for riders.
  • Enhanced with stronger fog resistant properties, the insert lens has extended fog resistant endurance which helps riders see better through challenging weather conditions.
  • The Pinlock 70 creates a double shield system through a silicon seal between the helmet face shield and Pinlock insert lens, which makes up a double glass type of solution that prevents fogging.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and therefore, the surface basically dry when used.
    This air-tight pocket ensures that the difference in temperature becomes significantly lowered.
  • The Pinlock insert absorbs moisture on the inside and offers you continuous clear visibility.

100% Max Vision:

The Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses maximizes fog resistant coverage within the helmet face shield via a custom designed cavity area that enables the lens to fit perfectly. Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses are also offered in colored versions.

name: SMK Spare Pinlock 70 Max Vision Lens for Gullwing
description:
Compatibility Note:

Only suitable for SMK Gullwing Helmets with 100% Max Vision (Pinlock 70) compatible face shields.

  • Pinlock 70 Lens only
  • Pinlock 70 Visor not included
  • Stock (Default) Pinlock 30 Visor will not be compatible with this lens.

Overview:

  • The 100% Max Vision Pinlock 70 fog resistant insert lens is a premium solution for SMK helmets.
  • This lens has become the benchmark for fog resistant performance that is most commonly used by riders across the world.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and, therefore the surface basically dry when used.
  • The insert has a silicone seal that creates a double shield system.
Specification:
  • Double shield system created by a silicon seal
  • Dry hydrofilic technology
  • Easy to clean and install
  • Interchangeable with other Pinlock lenses
  • 100% Max Vision® technology provides a clear view throughout the complete eye port of the shield

Overview:

  • The Pinlock 70 is a premium fog resistant solution for riders.
  • Enhanced with stronger fog resistant properties, the insert lens has extended fog resistant endurance which helps riders see better through challenging weather conditions.
  • The Pinlock 70 creates a double shield system through a silicon seal between the helmet face shield and Pinlock insert lens, which makes up a double glass type of solution that prevents fogging.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and therefore, the surface basically dry when used.
    This air-tight pocket ensures that the difference in temperature becomes significantly lowered.
  • The Pinlock insert absorbs moisture on the inside and offers you continuous clear visibility.

100% Max Vision:

The Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses maximizes fog resistant coverage within the helmet face shield via a custom designed cavity area that enables the lens to fit perfectly. Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses are also offered in colored versions.

Overview:

  • The 100% Max Vision Pinlock 70 fog resistant insert lens is a premium solution for SMK helmets.
  • This lens has become the benchmark for fog resistant performance that is most commonly used by riders across the world.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and, therefore the surface basically dry when used.
  • The insert has a silicone seal that creates a double shield system.

Specification:

  • Double shield system created by a silicon seal
  • Dry hydrofilic technology
  • Easy to clean and install
  • Interchangeable with other Pinlock lenses
  • 100% Max Vision® technology provides a clear view throughout the complete eye port of the shield

Overview:

  • The Pinlock 70 is a premium fog resistant solution for riders.
  • Enhanced with stronger fog resistant properties, the insert lens has extended fog resistant endurance which helps riders see better through challenging weather conditions.
  • The Pinlock 70 creates a double shield system through a silicon seal between the helmet face shield and Pinlock insert lens, which makes up a double glass type of solution that prevents fogging.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and therefore, the surface basically dry when used.
    This air-tight pocket ensures that the difference in temperature becomes significantly lowered.
  • The Pinlock insert absorbs moisture on the inside and offers you continuous clear visibility.

100% Max Vision:

The Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses maximizes fog resistant coverage within the helmet face shield via a custom designed cavity area that enables the lens to fit perfectly. Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses are also offered in colored versions.

name: SMK Spare Pinlock 70 Max Vision Lens for Typhoon
description:
Compatibility Note:

Only suitable for SMK TYPHOON Helmets with 100% Max Vision (Pinlock 70 VISOR) compatible face shields.

Additional Notes: 

  • Pinlock 70 Lens only x 1 unit included
  • Pinlock 70 Visor NOT included

Overview:

  • The 100% Max Vision Pinlock 70 fog resistant insert lens is a premium solution for SMK helmets.
  • This lens has become the benchmark for fog resistant performance that is most commonly used by riders across the world.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and, therefore the surface basically dry when used.
  • The insert has a silicone seal that creates a double shield system.

Specification:

  • Double shield system created by a silicon seal
  • Dry hydrofilic technology
  • Easy to clean and install
  • Interchangeable with other Pinlock lenses
  • 100% Max Vision® technology provides a clear view throughout the complete eye port of the shield

Overview:

  • The Pinlock 70 is a premium fog resistant solution for riders.
  • Enhanced with stronger fog resistant properties, the insert lens has extended fog resistant endurance which helps riders see better through challenging weather conditions.
  • The Pinlock 70 creates a double shield system through a silicon seal between the helmet face shield and Pinlock insert lens, which makes up a double glass type of solution that prevents fogging.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and therefore, the surface basically dry when used.
    This air-tight pocket ensures that the difference in temperature becomes significantly lowered.
  • The Pinlock insert absorbs moisture on the inside and offers you continuous clear visibility.

100% Max Vision:

The Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses maximizes fog resistant coverage within the helmet face shield via a custom designed cavity area that enables the lens to fit perfectly. Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses are also offered in colored versions.

Note:

  • SMK Spares & Visor products do NOT qualify for returns, exchange and refund policy.

A smartly designed vent system on the top and mouth areas along with the clear vision of flat high-grade Pinlock® ready 70 visor offers full comfort even in extreme weather conditions, both during long trips and everyday commuting.

GULLWING offers a complete range of features such as Internal Retractable Sun Visor, Wind Stops, and Pinlock® 70 ready visor. Available in solid color and high-visibility versions, these helmets offer you complete Style & Safety!

name: SMK Spare Pinlock 70 Max Vision Lens for Stellar and Titan Helmets
description:
Compatibility Note:

Only suitable for SMK TITAN Helmets and SMK STELLAR Helmets with 100% Max Vision (Pinlock 70 VISOR) compatible face shields.

Additional Notes: 

  • Pinlock 70 Lens only x 1 unit included
  • Pinlock 70 Visor NOT included

Overview:

  • The 100% Max Vision Pinlock 70 fog resistant insert lens is a premium solution for SMK helmets.
  • This lens has become the benchmark for fog resistant performance that is most commonly used by riders across the world.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and, therefore the surface basically dry when used.
  • The insert has a silicone seal that creates a double shield system.

Specification:

  • Double shield system created by a silicon seal
  • Dry hydrofilic technology
  • Easy to clean and install
  • Interchangeable with other Pinlock lenses
  • 100% Max Vision® technology provides a clear view throughout the complete eye port of the shield

Overview:

  • The Pinlock 70 is a premium fog resistant solution for riders.
  • Enhanced with stronger fog resistant properties, the insert lens has extended fog resistant endurance which helps riders see better through challenging weather conditions.
  • The Pinlock 70 creates a double shield system through a silicon seal between the helmet face shield and Pinlock insert lens, which makes up a double glass type of solution that prevents fogging.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and therefore, the surface basically dry when used.
    This air-tight pocket ensures that the difference in temperature becomes significantly lowered.
  • The Pinlock insert absorbs moisture on the inside and offers you continuous clear visibility.

100% Max Vision:

The Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses maximizes fog resistant coverage within the helmet face shield via a custom designed cavity area that enables the lens to fit perfectly. Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses are also offered in colored versions.

Note:

  • SMK Spares & Visor products do NOT qualify for returns, exchange and refund policy.

SMK Allterra is the new MX addition to complete the SMK Range.
Made of 2 outer injected EIRT shells for optimized safety and comfortable fitting, it has been conceived by the world’s most famous MX experts for off-road lovers!

It features an easily removable and adjustable peak. With the washable and removable hypoallergenic liner equipped with anti-moisture management & antistatic properties, you are always good to go.

The channeled ventilation system with multiple air vents and air exhausts provides maximum comfort to the rider. The extra wide eye-opening allows firmly hosting mx goggles during x-riding which will allow an excellent view of the track.

Technical Specification:

  • Homologation: ECE R22-05 , DOT FMVSS No. 218 & ISI 4151
  • 2 shell sizes 
  • Injected EIRT shell
  • Extremely Lightweight : 1350 ± 50 grams
  • Easily removable and adjustable peak
  • Double D Rings locking system for maximum safety on road and off road.
  • Extra wide eye-opening allows firmly hosting most mx goggles

  • Proudly Made in India

  • Inner:
    • Vibrant fabric colors
    • Breathable, hypoallergenic liners
    • Fully removable and washable.
    • Resil coated comfort liner.
    • Antistatic & Moisture management Fabric
  • Air Ventilation:
    • Chin Air Vents
    • Side Air Vents
    • Channeled Exhausts
    • Hot Air Rear Exhausts

    Note:

    • Images / Videos shown are for illustration purpose.
    • Actual look, features and colors may vary as per manufacturer's updates without any further discretion.

name: SMK Retro Black Red Matt (MA230) Helmet
description:
SMK Retro never goes out of style! SMK Retro Unicolour is a full face helmet with timeless design aesthetics coupled with advanced impact absorption materials protecting the rider at all times.

The Retro full face comes with the unique transformation kit which you let you conveniently mix and match different aspects of the helmet such as the visors or the side plates.

The plush suede fabrics and real leather cushioning the rider’s face give an extra comfort and sense of richness to the helmet.

Extra side covers allow to remove visor and to use the helmet with goggles or sunglasses only.

name: STEELBIRD SBA 20 - 09 BT
description:
Steelbird SBA 20-09 BT Smart Flip-Up Helmet

Smart Connectivity. Superior Protection. Everyday Versatility.

The Steelbird SBA 20-09 BT Helmet is a next-generation smart modular helmet designed for riders who demand the perfect combination of safety, convenience, and connectivity. Featuring integrated Bluetooth 5.2 technology, a flip-up modular design, and advanced rider comfort features, the SBA 20-09 BT is ideal for daily commuting, touring, and long-distance rides.

Built with a high-impact thermoplastic ABS shell, the helmet delivers reliable protection while maintaining a lightweight and comfortable feel. The aerodynamic shell design improves stability at higher speeds by reducing wind resistance, while the sporty rear spoiler enhances both performance and style.

Its integrated Bluetooth 5.2 system allows riders to enjoy hands-free calling, GPS navigation prompts, music streaming, and voice command support without taking their focus off the road. With up to 48 hours of talk time and approximately 110 hours of standby time, the helmet is built to keep you connected on every journey. 

The modular flip-up mechanism offers the flexibility of both an open-face and full-face helmet, making it ideal for city traffic as well as highway touring. An integrated inner sun visor provides instant protection from glare, while the anti-scratch outer visor ensures clear visibility in varying riding conditions. 

Comfort is enhanced through a dynamic multi-vent ventilation system, breathable interior padding, and removable, washable liners that keep the helmet fresh during extended rides. The secure micrometric quick-release buckle ensures easy operation while providing a reliable fit every time. 

Key Features

Shell Construction

  • High-impact ABS thermoplastic shell.

  • Aerodynamic design for improved stability.

  • Sporty rear spoiler for enhanced performance and styling.

  • Lightweight construction for everyday comfort.

Smart Bluetooth Features

  • Built-in Bluetooth 5.2 connectivity.

  • Hands-free calling and music streaming.

  • GPS navigation audio support.

  • Voice command compatibility.

  • LED status indicator.

  • Up to 48 hours talk time and 110 hours standby time. 

Safety

  • ISI certified for Indian road use.

  • High-density EPS liner for effective impact absorption.

  • Secure micrometric quick-release buckle.

  • Reliable modular locking mechanism. 

Visor System

  • Anti-scratch outer visor.

  • Integrated inner smoke sun visor.

  • Wide field of vision for enhanced road awareness.

Ventilation

  • Dynamic multi-vent airflow system.

  • Efficient cooling for long rides.

  • Breathable interior with enhanced airflow channels.

Interior Comfort

  • Removable and washable liners.

  • Soft breathable padding with neck protector.

  • Comfortable fit for extended touring and commuting.

Why Choose the Steelbird SBA 20-09 BT?

The Steelbird SBA 20-09 BT combines smart Bluetooth connectivity, modular convenience, dependable protection, and rider-focused comfort into one versatile helmet. Whether you're navigating city traffic, touring across highways, or riding daily, it keeps you connected, comfortable, and protected throughout every journey.

Ideal For

  • Daily commuting

  • Highway touring

  • Urban riding

  • Long-distance travel

  • Riders seeking integrated Bluetooth functionality

Important Notes

  • Always ensure proper fit and secure fastening before riding.

  • Charge the Bluetooth system fully before extended rides.

  • Product colours, graphics, and specifications may vary depending on the selected variant.

Premium Comfort, Modern Style, and Trusted Protection

Experience every ride with confidence in the STUDDS Helios Full Face Helmet, a perfect fusion of advanced safety, contemporary design, and everyday comfort. Engineered for riders who demand reliable protection without compromising on style, the Helios delivers a premium riding experience whether you're commuting through the city or embarking on long-distance journeys.

Featuring a lightweight aerodynamic shell and an integrated sporty spoiler, the Helios is designed to enhance stability while reducing wind resistance and rider fatigue. Its sleek profile not only improves performance but also adds a modern, dynamic look that complements any riding style.

Built with rider convenience in mind, the helmet incorporates advanced ANTIFOG100 visor technology to ensure clear visibility in changing weather conditions. The premium silicon-coated dual visor system allows quick adaptation to varying light environments, providing enhanced comfort and confidence throughout your ride.

The thoughtfully designed interior includes an eyeglass-friendly fit, integrated speaker pockets for communication system compatibility, and a soft hypoallergenic liner that delivers exceptional comfort during extended riding sessions. The removable and replaceable liner also helps maintain freshness and hygiene over time.

Multiple stylishly integrated air vents promote continuous airflow throughout the helmet, helping regulate internal temperature and keeping riders cool even during long rides or warm weather conditions.

Safety remains at the heart of the Helios design. Certified to both ISI and DOT standards, the helmet features a high-impact resistant outer shell, regulated-density EPS liner, and a rustproof stainless-steel buckle system to provide dependable protection and long-lasting durability.

Available in a range of attractive solid colours, the STUDDS Helios Full Face Helmet allows riders to express their personality while enjoying premium safety, comfort, and performance.

Ventilation

  • Multiple strategically positioned air vents for optimized airflow.

Interior Comfort

Design & Style

  • Sleek, modern full-face helmet design.

Why Choose the STUDDS Helios Full Face Helmet?

The STUDDS Helios is designed to deliver the complete riding package—combining certified safety, modern comfort features, aerodynamic performance, and contemporary styling. The Vega Sonic Scope is a full-face racing helmet built for riders who want aggressive, motorsport-inspired styling combined with dependable everyday protection. Its aerodynamic shell features an integrated spoiler for improved high-speed stability and reduced wind drag, along with bold "SONIC" and "SCOPE" branding, sharp linear stripe detailing flowing from crown to chin, and the signature "Vega" logo at the rear — delivering a dynamic, track-inspired look. This sporty full-face helmet is available in multiple colorways, including Blue-Black, Red-Black, and Silver-Black with Orange accents, so riders can match their style and bike.

Key Features

  • Integrated rear spoiler for high-speed stability and reduced wind drag
  • Clear, scratch-resistant visor with smooth, secure locking mechanism
  • Multi-point ventilation for effective airflow and anti-fogging
  • Lightweight shell (approx. 1150g ± 50g) for reduced neck fatigue
  • Aerodynamic, race-inspired profile for daily and highway rides

Available Colors

  • Blue & Black
  • Red & Black
  • Silver, Black & Orange

Gear up with the Vega Sonic Scope — ISI certified protection meets race-inspired style. Order yours today!

name: Shade  Dual Visor Open Face Helmet
description:
See Clear. Ride Free.

The Vega Shade is a stylish open face helmet with dual visor, designed for riders who want everyday comfort combined with smart, urban-ready looks. Its glossy black finish, clean rounded silhouette, and integrated sun peak give it a modern, aerodynamic profile, while the open-face design ensures a wide field of vision and breathable comfort — making it one of the best open face helmets for daily commuting and city rides.

Featuring a Dual Visor System, the Shade lets riders switch instantly between a clear outer visor for regular riding and a retractable smoke visor for glare protection, eliminating the need for separate sunglasses. A soft cushioned chin strap, secure buckle lock, and plush removable interior padding ensure all-day comfort, while the sleek, minimal branding keeps the look versatile for any rider.

Certified ISI (IS:4151), the Vega Shade meets recognized Indian safety standards for impact resistance and retention strength — delivering dependable protection along with everyday style and functionality. Whether you're commuting through city traffic or enjoying a weekend ride, the Vega Shade open face dual visor helmet offers the perfect balance of safety, comfort, and modern design.

name: Vega Sniper Flip Up Helmet
description:
Vega Sniper – The Smart Flip Up Helmet for Everyday Riders

Meet the Vega Sniper, a flip up (modular) helmet built for riders who want the convenience of an open-face helmet with the protection of a full-face one, all in a single click. Whether you're commuting through city traffic or heading out on a long ride, the Sniper's flip-up mechanism lets you lift the chin bar instantly for a quick chat, a sip of water, or a toll booth stop without ever removing your helmet.

Key Highlights:

  • ISI Certified for Safety – Meets Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) safety norms, so you can ride with confidence on every journey.
  • Durable ABS Shell – Engineered from high-grade ABS material for a strong, impact-resistant outer shell that's lightweight yet tough.
  • Flip-Up Convenience – Smooth chin-bar mechanism gives you the flexibility of a full-face and open-face helmet in one.
  • All-Day Comfort – Cushioned interior padding designed for a snug, comfortable fit on long rides.
  • Clear Visor with UV Protection – Scratch-resistant visor for clear visibility in all riding conditions.
  • Sleek, Modern Design – A street ready look that pairs well with everyday commutes and weekend rides alike.

name: Cliff Pro Full Face Helmet With Spoiler
description: Vega introduces the Cliff Pro Full Face Helmet, a perfect blend of style, safety, and performance. Designed with a sleek spoiler for enhanced aerodynamics, this helmet ensures a stable ride even at high speeds. Its lightweight construction provides maximum comfort during long rides, while the premium texture finish adds a touch of elegance and durability.

name: Vega Boolean Optimus Flip-up Helmet with spoiler
description:
The Vega Boolean Optimus brings bold, sporty graphics to the trusted Boolean flip-up platform. Set on a glossy white base, the design features sharp red and blue angular accents that streak across the shell in a dynamic, motorsport-inspired pattern, with the "BOOLEAN" wordmark on the side and "OPTIMUS" branding at the rear. The signature "Vega" script logo sits on the front, while a sculpted rear spoiler adds an aerodynamic edge and enhances high-speed stability

Like the rest of the Boolean range, the Optimus features a smooth flip-up chin bar for easy on/off wear, a Dual Visor System with clear outer visor and retractable smoke inner sun visor, multi-point ventilation to reduce heat and fogging, and a quick-release "PUSH" visor lock mechanism.

Fully certified for safety, the Boolean Optimus is DOT certified (FMVSS No. 218) and ISI certified (IS:4151), ensuring dependable protection to match its striking, race-inspired looks.

name: Vega Boolean Shadow Flip up Helmet with spoiler
description:
The Vega Boolean is a premium flip up (modular) helmet that combines the convenience of an open-face helmet with the protection of a full-face shell. Its smooth chin bar mechanism lifts up easily for hands-free conversations or quick visor cleaning, making it ideal for daily commuters and touring riders. The helmet features a bold red, black, and white color scheme with sharp graphic lines and "BOOLEAN" branding, along with the signature "Vega" logo on the front and a "SHADOW" wordmark at the rear. An aerodynamic rear spoiler adds to its sporty profile while improving high-speed stability

Practical features include a Dual Visor System with a clear outer visor and a retractable smoke inner sun visor for instant glare protection, multi-point ventilation for continuous airflow and anti-fogging, a quick-release "PUSH" visor lock mechanism, and a removable, washable interior liner for all-day comfort and hygiene.

Safety is fully certified — the Vega Boolean is DOT certified (FMVSS No. 218) and ISI certified (IS:4151), confirming it meets recognized standards for impact absorption, penetration resistance, and retention strength. It's a helmet that delivers modular versatility, everyday comfort, and dependable, certified protection in one sporty package.

name: Vega Boolean Flip up Helmet with spoiler
description:
The Vega Boolean is a premium flip up (modular) helmet that combines the convenience of an open face helmet with the protection of a full face shell. Its smooth chin bar mechanism lifts up easily for hands free conversations or quick visor cleaning, making it ideal for daily commuters and touring riders. Available in sleek solid colors, the Boolean carries a clean, versatile look with the signature "Vega" logo on the front, and an aerodynamic rear spoiler that adds to its sporty profile while improving high speed stability.

Practical features include a Dual Visor System with a clear outer visor and a retractable smoke inner sun visor for instant glare protection, multi point ventilation for continuous airflow and anti-fogging, a quick-release "PUSH" visor lock mechanism, and a removable, washable interior liner for all-day comfort and hygiene.

Safety is fully certified — the Vega Boolean is DOT certified (FMVSS No. 218) and ISI certified (IS:4151), confirming it meets recognized standards for impact absorption, penetration resistance, and retention strength. It's a helmet that delivers modular versatility, everyday comfort, and dependable, certified protection in one sporty package.

name: Vega Crux Checks Dual Visor Helmet
description: Ride with confidence and style with the Vega Crux Checks Dual Visor Flip-Up Helmet. Designed for safety, comfort, and convenience, it features a high-impact outer shell with a shock-absorbing EPS liner for reliable protection. The dual visor system provides clear vision in varying light conditions, while the flip-up design offers added practicality for everyday rides. Soft, breathable, removable inner padding ensures lasting comfort and easy maintenance, and the textured finish adds a modern, premium look. Lightweight yet durable, the Vega Crux Checks is the perfect companion for daily commutes and long rides alike.

name: MT - X PULSE 200 AIR FILTER
description:
Hyper Flow Air Filter for Hero X Pulse 200 2V/4V/2T


Description:

Cotton Gauze Air Filters Offer Several Benefits Compared To Traditional Paper Or Foam Air Filters. Here Are Some Of The Advantages Of Using Cotton Gauze Air Filters:

Improved Airflow:
Cotton Gauze Filters Are Designed To Allow Maximum Airflow While Still Effectively Capturing Dirt And Debris. The Porous Nature Of The Cotton Material Allows Air To Flow More Freely, Which Can Enhance Engine Performance By Promoting Better Combustion And Increasing Horsepower.

Better Filtration Efficiency:
Cotton Gauze Filters Provide Superior Filtration Compared To Paper Or Foam Filters. The Multiple Layers Of Cotton Gauze Are Tightly Woven, Allowing Them To Effectively Trap Smaller Particles Such As Dust, Pollen, And Other Contaminants. This Helps Prevent Engine Damage And Prolongs The Life Of The Engine By Reducing The Amount Of Dirt That Enters The Combustion Chamber.

Reusability And Longevity:
One Of The Significant Advantages Of Cotton Gauze Filters Is That They Can Be Cleaned And Reused Multiple Times. Unlike Paper Filters That Need To Be Replaced Regularly, Cotton Gauze Filters Can Be Washed, Reoiled, And Reinstalled, Which Makes Them More Cost-Effective And Environmentally Friendly In The Long Run.

Enhanced Durability:
Cotton Gauze Filters Are Generally More Durable And Robust Than Traditional Paper Or Foam Filters. The Cotton Material Is Resistant To High Temperatures And Can Withstand Greater Pressure Differentials Without Collapsing Or Tearing. This Makes Cotton Gauze Filters Suitable For High-Performance Applications Or Off-Road Driving Conditions Where The Filter May Be Subjected To More Challenging Environments.

Improved Engine Protection:
By Providing Better Filtration And Maintaining Optimal Airflow, Cotton Gauze Filters Help Protect The Engine From Contaminants That Can Cause Wear And Damage. Clean Air Is Essential For The Efficient Operation Of The Engine, And Using A Cotton Gauze Filter Can Contribute To A Cleaner And Healthier Engine Over Time.

It's Important To Note That While Cotton Gauze Filters Offer These Advantages, Proper Maintenance Is Necessary To Ensure Optimal Performance. Regular Cleaning And Reoiling According To The Manufacturer's Instructions Are Essential To Maintain The Filter's Effectiveness.

What are the Bluetooth Specifications?

  • Support: Swipe-based gesture control
  • Google Assistant Integration: Yes
  • Call Accept Feature: Yes
  • Call Reject Feature: Yes
  • Voice: -38+3dB
  • Range: 10m in Line of Sight
  • Usage Temperature: -20°C to 60°C

How do I Charge the helmet?

  • Use the provided magnetic charging cable to charge the helmet.
  • Only use a DC 5V/1A adapter to avoid damage.
  • Charging: Red LED is continuously ON.
  • Charging Complete: Red LED turns OFF.
  • A full charge takes approximately 2 hours. 
  • Battery status will be displayed once connected to your smartphone.

Can I use the helmet in the rain?

  • Yes, the helmet is water-resistant, but avoid submerging it in water.

How do I reset the helmet?

  • Press and hold the power button for 10 seconds to reset.

What are the recommended operating conditions for optimal performance of the device?

For best performance:

  • Use the device in ambient temperatures below 45°C to maintain electronic efficiency.
  • Always wear a properly fitted helmet as designed, since modifications can impact acoustic fidelity and gesture recognition accuracy.
  • While the device works in moderate rain, dry environments are recommended for optimal audio quality.

What can I expect in terms of audio performance during calls, music playback, and voice assistant use while riding?

  • Call Clarity: You'll experience ≥98% word recognition in static or urban conditions up to 60 km/h. The voice remains audible up to 100 km/h, though minor distortion may occur due to wind. It's advised to avoid high-speed calls above 100 km/h for safety.
  • Music Playback: The system delivers clear mid and high frequencies. Slight distortion may occur above 100 km/h due to wind and noise, and also at 90–100% volume levels, though this does not affect overall performance.
  • Voice Assistant: Commands like “Hey Siri” or “Ok Google” are reliably recognised at speeds up to 90 km/h. At speeds beyond 100 km/h, occasional false activation may occur. 

How reliable and responsive are the gesture controls while riding?

The gesture controls are designed for high accuracy and reliability:

  • False Activation Prevention: Gestures are not falsely triggered by normal head movements, even at speeds over 120 km/h, wind impact up to 120 km/h, or in light to moderate rain.
  • Gesture Latency: All recognized gestures are executed with a delay of less than 2 seconds, ensuring quick and seamless interaction while riding.

What are the system and power performance specifications of the device?

  • Boot Time: The device powers on and becomes active within 4 seconds.
  • Bluetooth Pairing: Connects with previously paired devices in 4 seconds or less.
  • Battery Life: Offers over 12 hours of continuous use, including music and calls.
  • Overheat Tolerance: Functions reliably at ambient temperatures up to 45°C.
  • Audio Routing Priority: Automatically priorities audio in the following order — Calls > Music > Navigation — for a seamless user experience.

What are the Bluetooth and connectivity capabilities of the device?

  •  Classic Bluetooth Compatibility: The device supports simultaneous operation of  Classic Bluetooth without any packet loss or audio drop.
  • Auto Reconnect: If the connection drops, it automatically reconnects to the last paired device within 10 seconds.
  • Connectivity Range: Maintains a stable Bluetooth connection up to 20 meters in a clear line-of-sight environment.

What are the general recommendations for optimal use of the device?

To ensure the best performance and user experience:

  • Always wear the helmet with a firm and proper fit to maintain correct mic and speaker alignment.
  • Use the device with smartphones that support BLE 4.0 or higher for smooth connectivity.
  • Avoid riding in extreme weather conditions, such as storms, to minimise audio interference.
  • Fully charge the device before long rides to ensure uninterrupted usage.
  • Keep the firmware updated to maintain compatibility and optimal performance.

description:
MotoVibe Helmet Chin Mount for Action Cameras – VEGA BOLT

Capture smooth, immersive riding footage with the MotoVibe Helmet Chin Mount for Action Cameras – VEGA BOLT, precision-designed to fit Vega Bolt helmets. Perfect for motovloggers, touring riders, and everyday commuters, this chin mount delivers a stable POV angle without compromising helmet comfort, safety, or aerodynamics.

  • Secure Action Camera Mount: Compatible with popular action cameras

  • Ideal POV Chin Angle: Produces natural and immersive riding footage

How to Mount

1) Test the fit and position of the chin mount on your helmet before installation.

2) Clean the helmet surface with an alcohol swab and let it dry for 5 minutes.

3) Peel off the adhesive cover and place the mount on the chin area.Confirm it's position and press firmly to secure it. DO NOT HEAT THE ADHESIVE.

4) Leave the mount undisturbed for 24 hours before attaching your GoPro.

description:
MOTOTECH Anti Fog Visor Insert Universal Clear

Designed for use during both day and night, this Anti Fog Visor Insert is the perfect solution for eliminating any optical distortion on almost all helmet visors, with or without pinlock pins. Its unique adhesive sealant firmly adheres to the visor, preventing any dust from entering between the insert and the visor.

No pins are required for mounting, making it a convenient and safe choice for all riders.

Compatible With:  
This product is a universal fit, fits Majority of Leading Brands Helmets*

 No warranty / Returns / Exchanges applicable on Anti fog Lens 

    Disclaimer:

    • Images shown for illustration purpose only.
    • Actual product may vary in finish, specifications, look without any discretion from manufacturer.
    • Anti fog lenses do NOT qualify for any exchange, returns, or replacements.

    Features:

    • This visor insert offers a clear and transparent solution for optimal visibility.
    • Provides anti-fog properties.
    • Utilizing a patented glue sealing system, this stick-on type visor insert adheres to the inner portion of your visor with high-quality glue.
    • Suitable for use during both day and night.
    • 100% optically precise film ensures clear vision without any distortion.
    • Help protect your visor from dust and dirt with our anti-fog visor insert - a universal, clear solution that will not damage your visor.
     Weight 100 gms
    Dimension (Width x Height) 272 x 91mm (27.2 x 9.1cm)
     

    Installation: 

    STEP: 1
    • Wash your hands and find a clean dry surface
    • Open the package and use the given microfiber cloth to clean up the helmet visor
      from both sides
    • Ensure that your helmet visor is clean and dry before installing the Anti-fog Visor Insert

    STEP: 2

    • Remove the Positioning Mask with the RED tag from the MotoTech Anti-fog Visor Insert
    • Keep the rest of the Visor Insert on a clean and dry surface

    STEP: 3

    • Take out the 2 x REMOVE marked stickers
    • Place the Positioning Mask on the outside of your visor. This will act as a guide while installing the Anti-fog Insert
    • Adjust the Positioning Mask freely until the ‘+ ’ sign is at the center of your visor

    STEP: 4

    • Remove visor from the helmet & keep on a clean & dry surface, inner side facing upwards
    • Flex the Anti-fog Visor Insert and align the ‘ + ’ on the insert with the ‘ + ’ on the Positioning Mask
    • Important Step: Make the insert touch the middle of your helmet visor, and then gently press the insert from the middle to both sides with your two hands

    STEP: 5

    • Hold the helmet visor with one hand and press the fingers of the other hand with the microfiber fabric around the edge of the Anti-fog Insert for best adhesion

    STEP: 6

    • Remove the Protective Film Mask with the BLUE tag
    • Remove the Positioning Mask with the RED tag

    To be installed once only, if removed cannot be re-applied.

name: AXOR VISOR
description:
Introducing the AXOR XCross Dual Visor Flash Gloss Neon Yellow Red Helmet, a dynamic fusion of style, safety, and versatility designed to elevate your riding experience.

Crafted with precision and engineered to meet the highest safety standards, this helmet ensures maximum protection and comfort on any terrain.

Compliant with ECE R-22.05 (Europe), DOT FMVSS NO. 218 (US), and ISI Helmet Safety Standards, the AXOR XCross Helmet undergoes rigorous testing to ensure superior performance in various conditions.

From energy attenuation to penetration resistance, every aspect of this helmet is meticulously tested to guarantee your safety on the road.

The ventilation system of the AXOR XCross Helmet is strategically designed to maximize airflow, keeping you cool and comfortable during intense rides.

Multiple air vents, including the mouth and upper air ventilation system, ensure optimal breathability, while the included nose guard/wind deflector prevents cold wind from affecting your nose.

Equipped with an optically correct visor and an inner smoke sun visor, this helmet provides clear vision in any lighting conditions.

The quick and tool-less visor change mechanism allows for easy replacement, while the pins on the visor ensure compatibility with pin lock film for added anti-fog protection.

Safety is paramount, which is why the dual EPS liner of the AXOR XCross Helmet is designed to absorb impact energy and prevent penetration.

The double D-ring retention system ensures a secure fit, while the high-impact thermoplastic ABS material provides durability and protection.

Designed for versatility, the dual sport peak of the AXOR XCross Helmet is easily removable and adjustable, allowing you to customize your riding experience.

The peak and shell are engineered for all trails, while the goggle holding shape ensures a perfect fit for your goggles.

With vibrant colors for a sporty look and washable liners and interiors for easy maintenance, the AXOR XCross Helmet combines style and functionality seamlessly. Weighing up to 1350±50 grams, this helmet offers lightweight comfort without compromising on safety.

description:
Bmc Air Filter For Royal Enfield Himalayan 411 (2018)/ Scram 411 (Till 2022) - Fm966/08

Description:

•    The Panel / Cylindrical Air Filter Is Commonly Referred To As “Replacement Air Filter”

•    The Rubber Used In Bmc Air Filtering Systems Has A Long Life, Is Very Durable And Has Optimum Adhesion Characteristics To All Shapes Of Airboxes
•    Bmc Filters Are Made Of A Multi-Layered Cotton Gauze Soaked With Low Viscosity Oil Covered With An Epoxy Coated Alloy Mesh To Ensure Protection From Petrol Fumes And Oxidization Due To Air Humidity
•    All Bm Air Filters Are Pre-Oiled, And They Can Be Washed And Regenerated By Using The Appropriate Bmc Regeneration Kit

    What’s Covered:

     

    Manufacturing defects in zippers, stitching, or buckles

    Faulty or misaligned mounting straps, loops, or adjusters

    Fabric delamination due to poor bonding (non-external cause)

    Water leakage from waterproof models only when used correctly and without damage

    What’s Not Covered:

     

    Damage due to misuse, overpacking, or improper installation

    Abrasion or tearing caused by contact with sharp or hot surfaces (e.g., exhaust, grab rails, tire rub)

    Color fading, stains, or discoloration due to sunlight, water, fuel, or sweat

    Water seepage or leakage in non-waterproof models (such as semi-water-resistant bags)

    Damage from storing wet gear, mold build-up, or mildew

    Broken buckles or straps due to excessive tension or incorrect mounting

    Any loss of belongings or contents kept inside the luggage

    Damage due to accidents, drops, or third-party modifications

    Waterproof performance compromised due to cuts, abrasion, or overuse

    Waterproof bags are designed to resist moderate to heavy rain under normal riding conditions. However, submersion, washing machine cleaning, or use of sharp tools will void waterproof protection claims.

     

    Warranty is non-transferable and applies only to items purchased through the official Raida website or authorized dealers.

name: AXOR APEX HELMET
description:
AXOR APEX MARVEL SPIDER MAN EDITION FULL-FACE HELMET WITH SPOILER

Your spider-sense will thank you. The AXOR APEX Spider Man Edition is a fully licensed Marvel helmet, built for riders who want to swing through traffic with the confidence of a true web-slinger. The shell is wrapped in bold white web-line graphics slashing across deep gunmetal-black — like Spidey himself left his trail etched into the composite — with the iconic spider emblem stamped boldly on the back, a mark only true Marvel fans will recognize and salute.

Up front, the dual visor system is your very own set of spider-lenses — a crystal-clear outer visor for maximum protection paired with a smooth, glare-free inner shield for changing light, so nothing dulls your senses whether you're riding into daylight or dusk. Snaps the visor in and out in seconds — fast, secure, effortless, just like Spidey swapping gear mid-swing. Paired with the genuine Pinlock 30 anti fog layer, your vision stays razor-sharp through rain, cold, or fog — because a hero's sight should never be compromised.

Underneath the styling is real hero-grade engineering — a multi-point ventilation systemchanneling fresh air through the crown and chin to keep you cool through every chase across the city, and an aerodynamic rear spoiler that keeps you steady and planted at speed, the same way Spider-Man stays grounded mid-swing through Manhattan's skyline.

And beneath the graphics, this is armor built to protect: a high-impact composite shell triple-certified to ISI IS:4151, DOT FMVSS No. 218, and ECE 22.06 — because even a hero doesn't ride without real protection.

The AXOR APEX Marvel Spider Man Edition — for the rider who doesn't just wear a helmet, but wears the legacy of a legend.

description:
Product Description: 

  • The Pinlock 30 fog-resistant insert lens is Pinlock’s entry-level solution for multiple brands that easily outperforms the strict ECE standard’s mist-retardant test.
  • All Pinlock 30 insert lenses come in a universal size that fits all Pinlock 30-compatible helmets.

Specification:

  • Double shield system created by a silicone seal
  • Dry hydrophilic technology
  • Easy to clean and install
  • Interchangeable with other Pinlock lenses
  • 100% Max Vision® technology provides a clear view throughout the complete eye port of the shield

Overview:

  • Pinlock’s entry-level solution for a resistant insert lens that has passed the strict ECE mist-retardant test standards with flying colours.
  • The Pinlock 30 insert lenses can be commonly found in basic to mid-range helmets on the market.
  • The insert lens creates a double shield system through a silicone seal between the helmet face shield and the Pinlock insert lens, which makes up a double-glass type of solution that prevents fogging.
  • The insert is made of a moisture-absorbing plastic and therefore, the surface is basically dry when used. This airtight pocket ensures that the difference in temperature is significantly reduced.
  • The Pinlock insert absorbs moisture on the inside and offers you continuous clear visibility.
  • The Pinlock 30 lens is made in a universal size that enables it to be fitted well in all Pinlock® 30-prepared helmet face shields.

Color: The Pinlock clear insert lens is the default colour option that is commonly offered by helmet manufacturers. As the Pinlock clear insert lens is transparent, it works well with all types of coloured types of face shields.

Compatibility:

  • Only suitable for SMK Helmets with Pinlock 30-compatible face shields for Hybrid / Twister / Glide / Force / Stellar / Typhoon / Gullwing

Note:

  • Pinlock 30 Lens only
  • Pinlock 30 Visor not included
  • Pinlock 70 Visor will not be compatible with this lens.

Note: Pinlock Lens is not covered under any warranty.

description:
CLICK HERE to Shop Now from OutdoorTravelGear.com

Anti Fog Visor Insert - Universal - Clear

Designed for use during both day and night, this Anti Fog Visor Insert is the perfect solution for eliminating any optical distortion on almost all helmet visors, with or without pinlock pins. Its unique adhesive sealant firmly adheres to the visor, preventing any dust from entering between the insert and the visor.

No pins are required for mounting, making it a convenient and safe choice for all riders.

Features:

  • This visor insert offers a clear and transparent solution for optimal visibility.
  • Provides anti-fog properties.
  • Utilizing a patented glue sealing system, this stick-on type visor insert adheres to the inner portion of your visor with high-quality glue.
  • Suitable for use during both day and night.
  • 100% optically precise film ensures clear vision without any distortion.
  • Help protect your visor from dust and dirt with our anti-fog visor insert - a universal, clear solution that will not damage your visor.
Weight 100 gms
Dimension (Width x Height)  272 x 91mm (27.2 x 9.1cm)

 

Installation: 

STEP # 1

  • Wash your hands and find a clean dry surface
  • Open the package and use the given microfiber cloth to clean up the helmet visor
    from both sides
  • Ensure that your helmet visor is clean and dry before installing the Anti-fog Visor Insert

STEP # 2

  • Remove the Positioning Mask with the RED tag from the MotoTech Anti-fog Visor Insert
  • Keep the rest of the Visor Insert on a clean and dry surface

STEP # 3

  • Take out the 2 x REMOVE marked stickers
  • Place the Positioning Mask on the outside of your visor. This will act as a guide while installing the Anti-fog Insert
  • Adjust the Positioning Mask freely until the ‘+ ’ sign is at the center of your visor

STEP # 4

  • Remove visor from the helmet & keep on a clean & dry surface, inner side facing upwards
  • Flex the Anti-fog Visor Insert and align the ‘ + ’ on the insert with the ‘ + ’ on the Positioning Mask
  • Important Step: Make the insert touch the middle of your helmet visor, and then gently press the insert from the middle to both sides with your two hands

STEP # 5

  • Hold the helmet visor with one hand and press the fingers of the other hand with the microfiber fabric around the edge of the Anti-fog Insert for best adhesion

STEP # 6

  • Remove the Protective Film Mask with the BLUE tag
  • Remove the Positioning Mask with the RED tag

*To be installed once only, if removed cannot be re-applied.*

Note: 

- Images shown for illustration purpose only.
- A pictorial Installation Guide is also included with the product.

Q: Is this riding innerwear suitable for both summer and winter?

A: The base layer features waterproof construction that helps manage moisture exposure from outside elements, keeping you dry and comfortable during your ride.

A: Yes — the Raida Thermal Base Layer Top is specifically designed to be worn inside a riding jacket, making it an ideal base layer that adds warmth without interfering with your outer riding gear.

 

Q: Is this innerwear suitable for long-distance tours?

A: Absolutely. Its thermal warmth, waterproof build, and hip armor protection make it a practical companion for long-distance touring in cold or variable weather conditions.

A: The Raida Thermal Base Layer Top is built for riding comfort and protection. For specific anti-odour details, we recommend checking the product label or contacting Raida directly.

Designed for riders who explore both highways and trails, these boots feature a modern dial closure system, superior protection, and all-day comfort, making them ideal for long-distance touring and adventure rides.Following these cleaning and maintenance tips will help prolong the life of your riding boots and keep them looking and performing their best.

 CARE & MAINTENANCE 

Regular Cleaning: After each ride, wipe down your boots with a damp cloth to remove any dirt, dust, or mud. Pay special attention to the soles and any areas with visible grime.

Leather Care: If your riding boots are made of leather, use a leather cleaner specifically designed for footwear. Apply the cleaner according to the manufacturer’s instructions and use a soft brush or cloth to gently scrub away any stains or marks. After cleaning, apply a leather conditioner to moisturize and protect the leather from drying out.

Waterproofing: If your boots are not already waterproof, consider applying a waterproofing spray or wax. This will help protect them from water damage and extend their lifespan.

Drying: If your boots get wet, allow them to air dry naturally. Avoid placing them near direct heat sources like radiators or using a hairdryer, as excessive heat can damage the leather or cause it to crack.

Odor Control: To keep your boots smelling fresh, sprinkle some baking soda or use odor-fighting inserts specifically designed for footwear. This will help absorb moisture and neutralize unpleasant odors.

Sole Maintenance: Check the condition of the soles regularly. If you notice excessive wear or damage, consider getting them resoled by a professional cobbler to maintain traction and ensure safety while riding.

Storage: When not in use, store your boots in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Avoid stacking heavy objects on top of them, as this can deform the shape of the boots.

Zipper Care: If your boots have zippers, keep them clean by wiping them with a damp cloth regularly. Apply a silicone-based lubricant or zipper wax to ensure smooth operation.

Replace Insoles: If the insoles of your boots are removable, consider replacing them periodically to maintain comfort and support.

name: VEGA HELMET SONIC
description:
The Korda Sonic GP Spi-D helmet is crafted with and advanced IRP+ shell for superior impact protection and is certified with ECE 22.06 and ISI certifications. The helmet comes with multi-density EPS, moisture-wicking fabric, D-ring fastener, emergency cheek pad release and a complimentary smoke visor.

Key Features

Shell Construction

  • IRP+ Shell Technology: Made with KORDA’s proprietary Impact Resistant Polymer Plus (IRP+), delivering exceptional strength and energy dispersion without unnecessary weight.

  • Shell Sizes: A Single shell configuration ensures consistent protection across all sizes.

  • Weight: Approx. 1600 g ± 50 g, balancing lightweight wear with robust safety.

Safety & Certifications

  • ECE 22.06 Certified: Meets the latest European safety standards for superior impact protection.

  • ISI 4151 Certified: Fully homologated for Indian roads and riding conditions.

  • Double D-Ring Retention: Secure, race-grade fastening system for precise adjustment and safety.

  • Emergency Release: Built-in cheek pad pull-tabs for safe helmet removal in emergencies.

Visor System

  • Dual Visor System: Optically correct, clear visor that provides wide, distortion-free vision with a precise, weather-sealed fit and an Integrated drop-down sun visor for quick adaptation to bright light.

  • Complimentary Smoke Visor: Comes with a smoke visor free in the box for sunny or bright riding conditions. 

Interior Comfort & Functionality

  • Multi-Density EPS Liner:  Layered foam absorbs impact progressively across critical zones.

  • Removable & Washable Liners: Easy to maintain for lasting hygiene and comfort.

  • Moisture-Wicking & Anti-Bacterial Fabric: Keeps the interior cool, dry, and fresh even on long rides.

  • Intercom Ready: Pre-shaped speaker pockets allow smooth integration with communication systems.

Ventilation System

  • Advanced Airflow Channels: Front intakes, internal ducts, and rear exhaust ports ensure continuous airflow.

  • Aero Rear Spoiler: Improves stability, reduces drag, and enhances ventilation dynamics at higher speeds. An optional short spoiler can be purchased separately here.

Riders looking for a versatile helmet that blends sport-inspired aerodynamics, modern safety standards, and premium comfort in one sleek full-face design.
